SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. 2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 29, 1935.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
No. S. P. D. 2882
Branch 8-35

Subject Comment on article entitled "9 Members of Russian Club do League Act" published in the "China Press" of August 13, 1935.

Made by D.S. Makaroff. Forwarded by D S I Payne

With reference to the attached cutting from the "China Press" of August 13, 1935, containing a report regarding nine members of "Soro" walking out on the annual general meeting of the above organization, I have to comment as follows:-

The Council of the United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai which is commonly known as "Soro," was established on January 17, 1932, by a number of "White" Russian organizations. At that time representatives of more than 40 Russian public organizations attended the general meeting which was held on the premises of the old French College on Route Vallon, the result of which was the election of Mr. A.M. Koteneff as president of the new body.

It should be noted that Mr. Koteneff played the major part and gave the maximum of his energy and toil in the founding of "Soro." He has since been greatly interested and has zealously watched every stage in the development of this organization.

However, on March 19, 1935, Mr. Koteneff was obliged to tender his resignation as president on account of his duties in the service of the Shanghai Municipal Council, and Dr. S.N. Shendrikoff, vice-chairman, has been authorised to act in Mr. Koteneff's place, pending the forthcoming elections of a new council.

In July, 1933, Dr. Shendrikoff was elected president of "Soro," which position he held until January, 1934, when he was succeeded by Gen. T.L. Gleboff.

On the appointment of Gen. Gleboff, dissensions arose in the organization due to this individual's dictatorial attitude, and members of the council divided into two groups.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE 30 AUG. 1935 SHANGHAI）
（批：Also see file D. 5002）

主题：对1935年8月13日《字林西报》（China Press）刊登的题为“俄国俱乐部九名成员退出联盟”一文的评论。

由 D.S. Makaroff 撰写。由警司佩恩（Payne）转呈

关于随附的1935年8月13日《字林西报》剪报，其中报道了“索罗”（Soro）组织的九名成员在该组织的年度大会上退席一事，本人评论如下：-

上海俄国公共组织联合会理事会（通常称为“索罗”）于1932年1月17日由多个“白俄”组织成立。当时，四十多个俄国公共组织的代表参加了在万隆路（Route Vallon）老法国公学旧址举行的全体会议，会议结果是选举 A.M. 科捷涅夫（A.M. Koteneff）先生为新机构的主席。

值得注意的是，科捷涅夫先生在创立“索罗”的过程中发挥了主要作用，并倾注了极大的精力和辛劳。此后，他一直对此深感兴趣，并热切关注该组织发展的每一个阶段。

然而，1935年3月19日，科捷涅夫先生因在上海公共租界工部局任职之故，不得不辞去主席职务，副主席 S.N. 申德里科夫（S.N. Shendrikoff）博士获授权在新一届理事会选举产生前代理科捷涅夫先生的职务。

1933年7月，申德里科夫博士当选为“索罗”主席，该职位他一直担任至1934年1月，随后由 T.L. 格列博夫（T.L. Gleboff）将军继任。

随着格列博夫将军的上任，由于此人独断专行的态度，组织内部产生了分歧，理事会成员分裂为两派，

（印：警务处处长办公室 1935年8月30日 上海）
（批：另见档案 D. 5002）

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, AUGUST 13, 1935

9 Members Of
Russian Club
Do League Act

Dissension Breaks Out
At Meeting Of Soro,
Nine Leave Conference

Nine members, including some of
the prominent Russians in the
local community, walked out on the
annual general meeting of Soro, a
society in which are represented all
Russian relief groups in this city.

The meeting, called to decide
upon a president, resulted in the
re-election of Mr. F. L. Glebov to
the position of chairman, but two
other major issues remained un-
decided.

The first dissension resulted from
an argument as to who should re-
present the Jewish Communal
Society. Messrs. Aron Fein and
Berkman, the old representatives,
claimed that they, being sent by
the Jewish Communal Society, were
the real representatives, while the
Society of Ashkinaze Jews in
Shanghai sent a letter to Mr. Glebov
prior to the meeting requesting that
Messrs. Hessin and Zimmerman be
the representatives. Mr. Glebov said
that if the Jewish Society could not
decide upon the matter among
themselves, he could not help them,
and that the matter would have
to rest until the next meeting. At
this Mr. Fein protested, saying that
in such a case major questions of
the Soro would be decided without
Jewish representatives. Mr. Glebov
waved this protest aside, whereupon
Mr. Fein and Mr. Berkman left the
meeting.

Following this, Mr. E. N. Shen-
drikoff, local attorney, protested
that the representation of the dif-
ferent association was not appro-
priate, stating as an example the
Fortune Benevolent Society, which,
by giving the number of its mem-
bers as 300, thereby got 3 members
on the executive committee, where-
as their membership totaled only
25. This protest was also denied
by Mr. Glebov, and on this Mr. E.
N. Shendrikoff, representing the
Union of Semerechenak Cossacks,
left the meeting. He was followed
by Mr. M. Katiboff, member of the
executive committee, Messrs. N.
Makrensky and G. Tumeniseff, of
the Russian Youth League, Messrs.
Vataleff and Dzeboyeff of the Rus-
sian Osetins, Dr. S. N. Shendrikoff,
vice-president, and Messrs. Bogolub-
off and Pukoff of the French Muni-
cipal College Students Relief Society.

《字林西报》，1935年8月13日，星期二

俄罗斯俱乐部
9名成员
采取联盟行动

索罗会议爆发分歧，
九人退出会议

包括本地侨民社会中一些知名俄罗斯人在内的九名成员，退出了索罗（Soro）的年度大会。索罗是一个代表了本市所有俄罗斯救济团体的协会。

此次会议旨在决定主席人选，结果是 F. L. Glebov 先生再次当选为主席，但另外两个主要问题仍未决断。

第一个分歧源于关于谁应代表犹太社区协会的争论。前任代表 Aron Fein 和 Berkman 两位先生声称，他们由犹太社区协会派遣，是真正的代表；而上海阿什肯纳兹犹太人协会在会前致信 Glebov 先生，要求由 Hessin 和 Zimmerman 两位先生担任代表。Glebov 先生说，如果犹太社团内部无法就此事项达成一致，他也爱莫能助，该事项须留待下次会议解决。对此，Fein 先生提出抗议，称在这种情况下，索罗的重大问题将在没有犹太代表的情况下做出决定。Glebov 先生对此抗议置之不理，随后 Fein 先生和 Berkman 先生离开了会议。

紧接着，当地律师 E. N. Shendrikoff 先生抗议各协会的代表权分配不当，并以福运善堂（Fortune Benevolent Society）为例指出，该会申报会员人数为300人，从而在执行委员会中获得了3个席位，而其实际会员总数仅为25人。Glebov 先生同样驳回了这一抗议，于是代表谢米列奇耶哥萨克联盟（Union of Semerechenak Cossacks）的 E. N. Shendrikoff 先生离开了会议。紧随其后离开的有：执行委员会委员 M. Katiboff 先生；俄罗斯青年联盟的 N. Makrensky 和 G. Tumeniseff 先生；俄罗斯奥塞梯人的 Vataleff 和 Dzeboyeff 先生；副主席 S. N. Shendrikoff 博士；以及法国市立学院学生救济会的 Bogoluboff 和 Pukoff 先生。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, MAY 13, 1935

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2882
Date 14 - 5 - 35

NEW "SORO" OFFICE
DECLARED OPEN

Protection Of Women,
Children Is Aim
Of Society

The new premises of "Soro,"
United Russian Organisations who
have joined hands with the Inter-
national Committee for the Pro-
tection of Women and Children,
were opened yesterday in Avenue
Dubail and Avenue Joffre. A
church service was held at 3 p.m.
Among those present were men
and women prominent in the Rus-
sian community and a number of
officers, including Major Darby and
M. Ch. Groubeff.

The new group, both headed
by General ... was prominent-
ly concerned with the campaign to
end white slavery in Shanghai and
to aid and protect destitute Rus-
sian women and children. The
publicity has been given the sub-
ject lately due principally to the
reports of proceedings of the
League of Nations ...
which stated that out of the
20,000 Russian women in China,
5,000 to 8,000 had been forced into
prostitution.

File
JW

保护妇女、
儿童是该协会
的宗旨

“索罗”（联合俄罗斯组织）的新址昨日在爱文义路与霞飞路交界处启用，该组织已与保护妇女儿童国际委员会携手合作。下午3时举行了教堂礼拜仪式。出席者包括俄罗斯社区中的知名男女人士以及数名警官，其中包括 Darby 少校和 Ch. Groubeff 先生。

这个由 ... 将军领导的新团体，主要致力于在上海终结白奴贸易的运动，并援助和保护贫困的俄罗斯妇女和儿童。最近公众对该问题的关注，主要归因于国际联盟......的会议报告，报告指出，在中国的20,000名俄罗斯妇女中，有5,000至8,000人被迫从事卖淫活动。

归档
JW

ful to the Police and I trust it will be continued.
As I explained at our interview each detective of the
Municipal Police is provided with a warrant card, signed
by a Deputy Commissioner, to prove his identity in case
he has occasion to seek information about official matters
from a member of the public with whom he is not acquainted.
I have instructed the members of the Special Branch to produce
these warrant cards whenever they make applications for
information at your office.

Subject Confidential communication dated 11.3.35 from the Council of United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai (SORO) re: authority of S.M.P. detectives to request information.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Ross

In connection with enquiries relating to various
Russian matters, Russian members of Section 2 of the Special
Branch, frequently have occasion to request information from
the Passport Office of the Public Safety Bureau, the Russian
Emigrants' Committee and the Council of United Russian Public
Organization at Shanghai (SORO). In the majority of cases
the information desired is limited to particulars of regist-
ration, passports, addresses and movements of persons regarding
whom enquiries are being made.

Enquiries among Russian detectives attached to various
stations show that they very rarely approach SORO for information

It is hardly necessary to say that members of the
Special Branch seeking information approach the above mentioned
institutions quite openly and are always prepared to produce
their warrant cards, if called upon to do so. For obvious
reasons, however, it is not always polite for the detectives
concerned to explain to the Secretary of SORO why the desired
information is required.

Early in 1933 Mr. A.M. Kotenev, who was then President
of SORO verbally instructed Mr. Afanassieff the then Secretary
of that organization not to give any information to detectives
of the Municipal Police unless they could produce on each
occasion a letter signed either by the Commissioner of Police
or the Head of the Department concerned.

Interviewed by a Russian member of the Special Branch
on this subject at that time, Mr. Kotenev seemed to have
realised the impractibility of such a procedure and therefore
cancelled his instructions. There has since been no difficulty
in obtaining information at that organization should it be

由 罗斯（Ross）总督察 呈报并转发

由于涉及各类俄国事务的调查，特别分部第二组的俄国成员经常需要向公安局护照科、俄侨委员会以及上海全俄侨民联合会（SORO）索取信息。在大多数情况下，所需信息仅限于被调查人员的登记详情、护照、地址及行踪。

对各分局附属的俄国侦探进行的查询显示，他们极少向全俄侨民联合会（SORO）索取信息。

毋庸赘言，特别分部成员在索取信息时，对上述机构的接触是完全公开的，并且随时准备在要求出示时展示其警员证。然而，出于显而易见的原因，相关侦探向全俄侨民联合会秘书解释为何需要所需信息，并不总是合乎礼节或适宜的。

1933年初，时任全俄侨民联合会主席的 A.M. 科特涅夫先生（Mr. A.M. Kotenev）口头指示该会时任秘书阿法纳西耶夫先生（Mr. Afanassieff），除非市政警察侦探每次都能出示由警务处长或相关部门主管签署的信函，否则不得向其提供任何信息。

当时，特别分部的一名俄国成员就此问题采访了科特涅夫先生，科特涅夫先生似乎意识到了这种程序的不切实际性，因此撤销了他的指示。此后，在该组织获取信息方面未再遇到困难，只要信息

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D. 2882 Date June 5, 1934）
Subject (in full) Status of the Council of United Russian Public Organisations
("SORO")
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by （手写签名）
The Council of United Russian Public Organizations at
Shanghai ("SORO"), an organization established by certain members
of the local "White" Russian community early in 1932 to serve as
an administrative body representing the Russian community as a
whole, encountered, for various reasons, serious opposition on
the part of another group headed by the Russian Emigrants'
Committee right from the beginning (Vide File D.2262). Consequently,
the movement towards the unification of local Russians, of which
the formation of the "SORO" was an outcome, proved a failure.
For this reason, the very name of this organization is somewhat
misleading.
Nevertheless, it was hoped by those who, irrespective of
their attitude towards the newly formed body, had sincerely
wished to bring about the unification of the local Russian
community, that in course of time the differences between the
leaders of the two opposing factions might be gradually smoothed
out and a compromise reached in the matter of establishing a
public body to represent the Russian community in Shanghai.
Had the "SORO", during the first few months of its existence,
proved its usefulness to the community, there would have been
nothing to prevent a mutual understanding and a settlement of
differences in a manner satisfactory to all parties being reached.
The reports on the activities of the "SORO" submitted
to the council of this organisation in the course of the annual
meeting of January 28, 1934, show that the "SORO" has failed to
increase its influence among the Russian community; on the
contrary, during the past year, about 60% of the members left
the "SORO". A list of the organisations which had severed
their connection with the "SORO" is attached herewith under
（左侧手写批注：v. 抄发）

事由（全称） 全俄侨民公共组织理事会（“SORO”）的地位
由 特别分部副督察 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）呈报 经 （手写签名） 转发
上海全俄侨民公共组织理事会（“SORO”）是一个由当地“白”俄社区某些成员于1932年初建立的、旨在作为代表整个俄裔社区的行政机构的组织，从一开始就因各种原因遭到了以俄侨委员会为首的另一个团体的强烈反对（参见档案 D.2262）。因此，以成立“SORO”为结果的当地俄国人统一运动证明是失败的。基于此原因，该组织的名称本身具有一定的误导性。
尽管如此，那些无论对新成立机构持何种态度、但真诚希望实现当地俄裔社区统一的人士曾希望，随着时间的推移，两派对立派别领导人之间的分歧可能会逐渐缓和，并在建立代表上海俄裔社区的公共机构问题上达成妥协。
如果“SORO”在其存在的最初几个月里证明了其对社区的用处，那么就没有什么能阻止各方达成相互理解并以令各方满意的方式解决分歧。
提交给该组织理事会的关于“SORO”活动的报告（在1934年1月28日的年度会议上）显示，“SORO”未能增加其在俄裔社区中的影响力；相反，在过去一年中，约60%的成员退出了“SORO”。已与“SORO”断绝关系的组织名单附于此处
（左侧手写批注：v. 抄发）

Appendix "A".

    On March 30, 1934, the 30 founders of the "SORO" who
in 1932 had signed the petition to the Nanking Government
asking for the registration of the institution, informed
the Chinese Authorities by letter that they were no longer
connected with the "SORO". A copy of this letter is attached
under Appendix "B".

    According to information, the falling off in the membership
of the "SORO" can largely be explained by the tendency of the
present leaders of that body to seek the intervention of the
Chinese Authorities in order to secure control over the whole
of the local Russian community. This tendency, in view of
the very poor support accorded to the "SORO" by the community,
aroused bitter criticism and opposition from the members of
the Russian community interested in public affairs, who maintain-
ed that the group of irresponsible and unscrupulous individuals
now forming the "SORO" - a quasi-public organization - were
utilizing the registration of that body with the local Bureau
of Social Affairs as a "licence" according them the exclusive
right to administer and represent the Russian community as a
whole.

    Another reason why certain Russian organizations severed
their connection with the "SORO" was the opposition against
General M. I. Afanasieff, the former paid Secretary of the
"SORO", who, in August 1933, was openly accused by a prominent
member of that body with being a secret Soviet agent. Although
this allegation has not been proved, the suspicion directed
against General Afanasieff has never been entirely dispersed.
Certain facts such as irregularities in connection with handling

    据信，“SORO”成员数量的减少很大程度上可归因于该机构现任领导人倾向于寻求中国当局的干预，以确保对整个当地俄裔社区的控制。鉴于社区对“SORO”的支持非常薄弱，这种倾向引起了关心公共事务的俄裔社区成员的严厉批评和反对，他们坚持认为，目前组成“SORO”这一准公共组织的一群不负责任且肆无忌惮的个人，正利用该机构在当地社会局的注册作为“许可证”，赋予他们管理和代表整个俄裔社区的专属权利。

    某些俄国组织与“SORO”断绝关系的另一个原因是对 M. I. 阿法纳西耶夫将军（General M. I. Afanasieff）的反对，他是“SORO”的前受薪秘书，曾在1933年8月被该会一名显要成员公开指控为苏联秘密特工。虽然这一指控尚未得到证实，但针对阿法纳西耶夫将军的怀疑从未完全消散。某些事实，例如在处理

The attitude of the local Chinese Authorities towards the

citizens wishing to apply for passports etc. have to call
personally at the office of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau,
Nantao, while until recently this was done through the medium
of either the Russian Emigrants Committee, 6A Hongkong Road, or

concerned, this new departure is the only practical result of the
"SOROSS" struggle for power. The possibility exists, however,
that certain privileges might have been granted to the "SORO"
by the Chinese Authorities by reason of the fact that the "SORO"
is registered with the local Bureau of Social Affairs.
Attached herewith (with translation) is a copy of an

在对本案进行的专门委员会调查过程中，揭露了挪用公款以及向各类刑事和政治嫌疑人签发注册证书等行为，导致阿法纳西耶夫将军（General Afanasieff）被俄罗斯全军联盟上海分会和俄罗斯民族共同体开除。尽管如此，他仍被允许以顾问身份参与“俄侨公会”（SORO）的活动。
中国地方当局对“俄侨公会”（SORO）的态度从未明确界定。目前，希望申请护照等的俄罗斯公民必须亲自前往南市上海市公安局办公室办理，而直到最近，此事还是通过香港路6A号的俄罗斯移民委员会或“俄侨公会”（SORO）代为办理。就当地俄罗斯社区而言，这一新举措是“俄侨公会”（SOROSS）权力斗争的唯一实际结果。然而，有可能中国当局因“俄侨公会”在当地社会局注册而给予了其某些特权。
随函附上（附译文）一份近期通过邮政在当地俄罗斯居民中流传的匿名传单（附录“C”）的副本，该传单内容极为粗俗。这是针对“俄侨公会”的一系列此类文件中的最新样本。

Subject (in full) Council of United Russian Public Organizations at
Shanghai (SORO) - new Presidium elected.
Made by D.S.L. Prokofiev Forwarded by D.J. Sorensen

Between 2.30 p.m. and 5 p.m. on January 28, 1934, annual
meeting of the "Council of the United Russian Public Organizations
at Shanghai" (SORO) was held in their offices at No.442 Avenue
Joffre. Twenty four members of the Council were present.
In his opening speech Dr.S.N.Shendrikoff,President of
the Council,acquainted those present with the general activities
of the Council during the past year,after which Dr.C.V.Hohlachkin,
Honorary Secretary,reported in detail on the activities of the
chancellery of the Council as well as on the changes,which had
taken place in the Presidium and general membership of the orga-
nization during the period under survey. The accounts of the Pre-
sidium for the year 1933 were then submitted to and approved by
the Council,following which the elections of the Presidium for
the current year took place.
The following persons were elected to serve in the new
Presidium:-
General Th.L. Gleboff President
Dr.S.N.Shendrikoff VicePresident
Mr.N.D. Markuloff Vice-President
Dr.C.V. Hohlachkin Hon. Secretary
Mr. S.S. Berkman Hon. Treasurer
In connection with the above it is of interest to note
that about a week prior to the meeting in question,an official
notice was published by SORO in the local Russian newspapers,in
which attention of the Russian community was drawn to the order
dated January 19,1934,received by SORO from the Shanghai Bureau
of Public Safety. In this order SORO," an organization duly regi-
stered with the Chinese Authorities" was called upon by the latter
to take a census of Russian emigrants residing in Shanghai and to

1934年1月28日下午2时30分至5时之间，“上海联合俄罗斯公共组织理事会”（俄侨公会）在其霞飞路442号的办公室举行了年度会议。理事会二十四名成员出席。
理事会主席 S.N. Shendrikoff 博士在开幕致辞中向与会者介绍了理事会过去一年的总体活动，随后，荣誉秘书 C.V. Hohlachkin 博士详细报告了理事会办事处的活动，以及在审查期间组织主席团和一般成员发生的变化。随后，主席团1933年度的账目提交理事会并获得批准，接着进行了本年度主席团的选举。
以下人员当选为新任主席团成员：-
Th.L. Gleboff 将军 主席
S.N. Shendrikoff 博士 副主席
N.D. Markuloff 先生 副主席
C.V. Hohlachkin 博士 荣誉秘书
S.S. Berkman 先生 荣誉司库
鉴于上述情况，值得注意的是，在上述会议前约一周，俄侨公会在当地俄罗斯报纸上发布了一则正式公告，提请俄罗斯社区注意俄侨公会于1934年1月19日收到的来自上海公安局的命令。在该命令中，俄侨公会作为一个“在中国当局正式注册的组织”，被要求对居住在上海的俄罗斯移民进行人口普查，并

On January 26, 1934, the "Shanghai Zaria" published an
interview with General Gleboff, one of the leaders of SORO, in
which he commented on the significance of the order referred to
above and stated that from now on SORO was the only Russian
organization in Shanghai recognized by the Chinese Authorities,
which had the right of registering Russian Emigrants in Shanghai.
The same point of view was expressed by Dr. S.N. Shendrikoff in
his speech at the annual meeting of SORO.
It will be recalled in this connection that SORO's claim
to represent the local Russian community as a whole, has never
been recognized by a large part of that community and that all
attempts to bring about an understanding between the two opposing
factions have so far been unsuccessful (File D. 2282).
According to our information the Chinese Authorities do
not consider SORO as the only Russian organization in Shanghai
representing the Russian community. From the reports on the
activities of SORO submitted to the Council of this organization
in the course of the annual meeting of January 28, 1934, it is
evident that there has been a considerable falling off in
membership of SORO during the past year. From 35 organizations

MEMORANDUM ON THE "COUNCIL OF UNITED RUSSIAN PUBLIC ORGANIZATION
AT SHANGHAI" ("SORO").

The establishing of the Russian emigrants organization
known as the "Council of United Russian Public Organization at
Shanghai" ("SORO") was an outcome of the so-called re-unification
movement in the local Russian community which was started in
October 1931 following the death of Mr. V. F. Grosse, Chairman
of the "Russian Emigrants Committee".

It will be recalled that since 1920 when the Imperial
Russian Consulate-General in Shanghai was closed by a decree of
the Chinese Government, Mr. Grosse, former Russian Consul-General,
continued to remain in charge of the interests of the local
Russian community on the post of the Assistant Commissioner of
the Bureau for Russian Affairs which was established by the
Chinese Authorities in the premises of the Russian Consulate-
General, No. 1 Whangpoo Road. In 1924 following the recognition
by China of the Government of Soviet Russia the Bureau for
Russian Affairs was closed and the building of the former
Russian Consulate-General was handed over by the Chinese
Authorities to representatives of the Soviet Government.

Mr. Grosse then established, in co-operation with
representatives of local Russian organizations, a public body
under the name of the "Committee for Defense of Rights of Russian
Emigrants". In 1926, however, the authority of Mr. Grosse to
represent the local Russian community was challenged by a group
of Russian organizations. As a result of this disagreement
Mr. Grosse supported by his followers formed another public
body under the name of the "Russian Emigrants Committee" which,
under his chairmanship, continued to exercise the functions of
the administrative centre of the Russian community in Shanghai.
This body has since maintained contact with the Council of
Russian Ex-Ambassadors in Paris.
page_data.zh:
关于“上海联合俄罗斯公共组织理事会”（“SORO”）的备忘录。

被称为“上海联合俄罗斯公共组织理事会”（“SORO”）的俄罗斯移民组织的建立，是当地俄罗斯社区所谓“重新统一运动”的结果，该运动始于1931年10月，即“俄罗斯移民委员会”主席 V. F. 格罗斯先生（Mr. V. F. Grosse）去世之后。

需回顾的是，自1920年中国政府下令关闭驻上海沙俄总领事馆以来，前俄国总领事格罗斯先生继续以中国当局在原俄国总领事馆（黄浦路1号）内设立的“俄侨事务局”助理专员的身份，负责当地俄罗斯社区的利益。1924年，随着中国承认苏维埃俄罗斯政府，俄侨事务局被关闭，原俄国总领事馆大楼由中国当局移交给苏联政府代表。

随后，格罗斯先生与当地俄罗斯组织代表合作，建立了一个名为“保卫俄罗斯移民权利委员会”的公共机构。然而，1926年，一群俄罗斯组织挑战了格罗斯先生代表当地俄罗斯社区的权威。由于这一分歧，格罗斯先生在其支持者的支持下成立了另一个名为“俄罗斯移民委员会”的公共机构，并在其主席领导下，继续行使上海俄罗斯社区行政中心的职能。该机构此后一直与巴黎的俄罗斯前大使理事会保持联系。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The opposing faction of the Russian community in
Shanghai was represented by the "Committee for Defense of Rights
of Russian Emigrants" of which Mr. N. I. Ivanoff, former consular
judge, was the Chairman. In 1929 this body was dissolved and
its functions handed over to an organization entitled the "Russian
National Community" of which Captain N. Y. Fomin was elected
Chairman. Organizations under this name were established in
several towns in the Far East by supporters of General Horvath
whom the late Grand Duke Nicolas appointed the Head of Russian
Emigrants in the Far East.

Both the "Russian Emigrants Committee" and the
"Russian National Community" were instituted with the object
of carrying out similar functions. Although the former body
undoubtedly predominated, this state of affairs could not be
considered either satisfactory or normal.

On October 23, 1931, at a meeting of the Russian
Juridical Society the situation in the Russian community in
connection with the death of Mr. Grosse was discussed and it
was unanimously resolved to recommend that the legal represen-
tation of the Russian community should rest with a special
neutral body which will take charge of the work of registration
of the Russian community, render legal assistance, issue and
certify documents, certificates of births, deaths etc. This
resolution was communicated to all existing Russian public
organizations in Shanghai and published in the local foreign
and Russian press.

On October 26, 1931, a meeting of representatives
of some 30 Russian organizations, convened at the initiative
of the "Russian National Community", was held in the premises
of the Russian Ex-Officers Club, 246 Route Vallon, to discuss
the question of legal and business representation of the Russian
community. The resolution of the Russian Juridical Society was
passed and the "Russian National Community" was authorized to
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

上海俄罗斯社区的反对派由“保卫俄罗斯移民权利委员会”代表，其主席为前领事法官 N. I. 伊万诺夫先生（Mr. N. I. Ivanoff）。1929年，该机构解散，其职能移交给一个名为“俄罗斯民族共同体”的组织，N. Y. 福明上尉（Captain N. Y. Fomin）当选为主席。在远东的几个城镇，霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）的支持者建立了同名组织，尼古拉大公生前曾任命霍尔瓦特将军为远东俄罗斯移民首领。

“俄罗斯移民委员会”和“俄罗斯民族共同体”的成立目的均在于履行类似的职能。虽然前者无疑占主导地位，但这种状况既不能令人满意，也不能视为正常。

1931年10月23日，在俄罗斯法律协会的一次会议上，讨论了因格罗斯先生去世而引发的俄罗斯社区局势，并一致通过决议，建议俄罗斯社区的法律代表权应归属于一个特殊的中立机构，该机构将负责俄罗斯社区的登记工作，提供法律援助，签发和认证文件、出生证明、死亡证明等。该决议已传达给上海所有现有的俄罗斯公共组织，并在当地外文和俄文报刊上发表。

1931年10月26日，应“俄罗斯民族共同体”的倡议，约30个俄罗斯组织的代表会议在华伦路246号俄罗斯退役军官俱乐部举行，讨论俄罗斯社区的法律和商业代表权问题。会议通过了俄罗斯法律协会的决议，并授权“俄罗斯民族共同体”

page_data.en:
- 3 -

enter into negotiations with the "Russian Emigrants Committee"
headed by Mr. Metsler, former Russian Vice-Consul in Shanghai,
with a view to establishing a new body on the lines indicated
in the above resolution. As a result of these negotiations
it was announced at the public meeting of representatives of
various Russian organizations held on November 12, 1931, that
a preliminary agreement had been reached between the two opposing
factions. A committee was then elected to compile the plan of
the constitution of the body as well as the order of its elections.
However, after several meetings of the committee it
became evident that the representatives of the two rival organi-
zations could not agree on certain points and, consequently,
negotiations were broken off, following which the "Russian
National Community" decided to carry on the work of unification
in co-operation with the so-called "third element" - organizations
and individuals who did not belong to either of the two organiza-
tions referred to above. On January 17, 1932, representatives
of the organizations supporting this scheme held a meeting during
the course of which it was decided to call the new organization
"The Council of United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai",
and a set of regulations was submitted and approved. The
following were then elected members of the Presidium of the
Council:-

In the beginning of February 1932 the "Council of
United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai" established its
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

与由前俄国驻上海副领事梅茨勒（Metsler）先生领导的“俄侨委员会”进行谈判，旨在按照上述决议所指出的方针建立一个新的机构。经过这些谈判，在1931年11月12日举行的各俄国组织代表公开会议上宣布，两个对立派别之间已达成初步协议。随后选举产生了一个委员会，负责编制该机构的章程草案及其选举程序。然而，经过委员会的几次会议后，显然这两个 rival 组织的代表在某些问题上无法达成一致，因此谈判破裂。此后，“俄国国民公会”决定与所谓的“第三势力”——即不属于上述两个组织的组织和个人——合作，继续开展统一工作。1932年1月17日，支持这一方案的各组织代表举行会议，期间决定将新组织命名为“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”，并提交并通过了一套规章。随后选举产生的理事会主席团成员如下：

A. M. 科特涅夫（Kotenev）先生
工部局秘书处附员 - 主席

N. Y. 福明（Fomin）上尉
“俄国国民公会”主席 - 副主席

V. I. 科尔尼洛夫（Korniloff）先生
“在华法国商业公司”经理，地址：霞飞路776号。 - 副主席

A. V. 塔尔莱（Tarle）博士
俄国医师协会主席。 - 荣誉秘书

V. A. 比洛夫（Byloff）先生
杂货店店主，地址：霞飞路413号。 - 荣誉司库

1932年2月初，“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”在

page_data.en:
- , 4 -

offices at No.39 Avenue Edward VII, and thus a new period in
the history of public life of the local Russian community was
opened.

Paragraph 3 of the "Regulations and Bye-Laws for the
Council of United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai" reads
as follows:-

"The Council adheres in furtherance of its
"objects and aims to the laws of the present
"Republic of China as well as to the
"administrative and municipal regulations
"in force in the International Settlement
"and French Concession of Shanghai".

In accordance with the above, a petition was submitted
to the Chinese authorities on June 30, 1932, requesting their
permission for the establishment and registration of the "Council
of United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai". This petition
was signed by 34 members of the council and was forwarded through
the medium of Dr. John C.H.Wu (Adviser to the Shanghai Municipal
Council and legal adviser of "SORO") to the Executive Committee
of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters.

On August 4, 1932, a reply was received from the local
Kuomintang Headquarters to the effect that permission for the
registration of the new body had been granted.

Taking into consideration that some of the regulations
governing the activity of Chinese public organizations are not
applicable within the territories of the foreign settlements and
may hinder the activity of the "Council of United Russian Public
Organization", the legal adviser of the Council applied to the
same authorities for a special certificate of registration. In
a reply dated October 6, 1932, the Executive Committee of the
Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters informed the
petitioners that pending the promulgation by the Central Committee
of the Kuomintang of regulations governing the establishment of
Foreign Residents Associations, no special certificate of regis-
tration (diploma) can be issued.

On October 18 and 19 the following official notification
which was drawn up by Dr. Wu and approved by the authorities
page_data.zh:
- , 4 -

爱多亚路39号设立了办事处，从而开启了当地俄侨公共生活史上的一个新时期。

《上海俄国公共组织联合理事会规章及细则》第三条规定如下：

“本理事会在推进其目标与宗旨时，遵守
‘中华民国现行法律’以及
‘上海公共租界和法租界内
‘现行的行政与市政规章’。”

根据上述规定，于1932年6月30日向中国当局提交了一份请愿书，请求批准成立并注册“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”。该请愿书由理事会34名成员签署，并通过吴经熊（John C.H.Wu）博士（上海工部局顾问及“SORO”法律顾问）转呈至国民党上海特别区党部执行委员会。

1932年8月4日，收到国民党地方党部的回复，大意是已批准该新机构的注册许可。

考虑到管理中国公共组织活动的某些规章并不适用于外国租界领土范围内，且可能会阻碍“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”的活动，该理事会的法律顾问向同一当局申请颁发特别注册证书。在1932年10月6日的回复中，国民党上海特别区党部执行委员会告知请愿人，在国民党中央委员会颁布关于外籍居民协会成立的规章之前，无法签发特别注册证书（文凭）。

10月18日和19日，以下由吴博士起草并经有关当局批准的官方通告

page_data.en:
- 5 -

concerned", was published in the "Chen Pao", organ of the
Kuomintang, the "Min Pao" and the "Shun Pao":-

"The United Russian Organization in Shanghai
hereby notifies the public of the following:-
Since some time recently the abovementioned
organization has been preparing for its formal
inauguration. At present, in compliance with
and by virtue of orders of the Shanghai Special
District Kuomintang Headquarters, dated August
4 and October 8, 1932 respectively, granting
permission for the establishment (inauguration),
a general meeting will be held at 4 p.m. on
Sunday November 6 at No.39 Avenue Edward VII
for the purpose of the formal inauguration of
this organization. The public is hereby
specially notified".

Considering that the registration with the Chinese
Authorities has introduced the Council into a new phase of its
activity, and with a view to facilitating the unification of all
Russian organizations in Shanghai into this body, the presidium
of the Council decided to resign from office and to invite all
organizations, which did not belong to the "SORO" group, to send
representatives to the meeting on November 6 for the purpose of
election of a new presidium in accordance with the statute of
"SORO". A notification to this effect was published in local
Russian newspapers on October 20.

On November 6, at a meeting attended by 37 of the
total number of 54 members of the "Council of United Russian
Public Organization", the formal inauguration of this body took
place, whereupon the following persons were elected into the
presidium:-

Mr. A. M. Kotenev .................... Chairman
Captain N. G. Fomin .................. Vice-Chairman
Dr. S. M. Shendrikoff ................ Vice-Chairman
Dr. K. V. Hoblachkin ................. Hon.Secretary
Mr. S. S. Berkman .................... Hon.Treasurer

It must be mentioned that out of 19 organizations not
belonging to "SORO" only one - a group of Russian emigrants of
Jewish nationality - sent its representatives to the above
meeting, the other organizations having declined the invitation
for various reasons.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

刊登在国民党机关报《晨报》、《民报》和《申报》上：

“上海俄国联合组织特此向公众通告如下：
近期以来，上述组织一直在筹备其正式成立事宜。
目前，遵照并依据国民党上海特别区党部分别于
1932年8月4日和10月8日发布的关于批准成立
（ inaugurated ）的命令，定于11月6日星期日下午4时
在爱多亚路39号举行全体会议，目的是正式
成立该组织。特此专门通告公众。”

鉴于向中国当局注册使理事会进入了其活动的新阶段，并且为了促进上海所有俄国组织统一加入该机构，理事会主席团决定辞职，并邀请所有不属于“SORO”团体的组织派遣代表参加11月6日的会议，以便根据“SORO”章程选举新的主席团。10月20日，当地俄文报纸刊登了以此为目的的通知。

11月6日，在“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”54名成员中的37名出席的会议上，该机构正式成立，随后选举下列人员进入主席团：

A. M. 科特涅夫（Kotenev）先生 .................... 主席
N. G. 福明（Fomin）上尉 .................. 副主席
S. M. 申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）博士 ................ 副主席
K. V. 霍布拉赫金（Hoblachkin）博士 ................. 荣誉秘书
S. S. 伯克曼（Berkman）先生 .................... 荣誉司库

必须提到的是，在不属于“SORO”的19个组织中，只有一个——犹太裔俄侨群体——派代表参加了上述会议，其他组织因各种原因拒绝了邀请。

page_data.en:
- 6 -

In compliance with Chinese law the minutes of this
meeting together with the statute of the new organization were
be submitted to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Head-
quarters and to the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai to be recorded in the registers of these
institutions.

The significance of the registration of "SORO" with
the Chinese authorities was explained by Mr. A. M. Kotenev as
follows:-

1. The registration of public organizations in China, other
than commercial and charitable, is a prerogative of the
Supreme Power which at present belongs to the Kuomintang
and its organs. Thus, the permission for registration
granted to "SORO", as an act of the Supreme Power of the
country, is therefore final and conclusive.

2. By the fact of registration with the Chinese authorities
"SORO" has acquired the full rights of a public body with
officially recognised legal status. The Russian community
in Shanghai is now represented not by one or several
individuals, but by an institution - to which aim the
community's aspirations have been directed at all times.

3. The Russian community has acquired an organ with notary
functions. Every document issued by the Council in
conformity with the Chinese laws and within the Council's
competence, has the force of an official document, of
which the validity and lawfulness can be disputed only
in courts.

4. The responsibility of the presidium of the Council and
of its executive officers for their acts is the same as
the responsibility of public officers for acts done in
their official capacity.

In connection with the registration of "SORO" with
the Chinese authorities the activity of this body generally
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

根据中国法律，本次会议纪要连同新组织的章程需提交至国民党上海特别区党部和上海特别市政府社会局，以便在这些机构的登记册中备案。

A. M. 科特涅夫先生对“SORO”向中国当局注册的意义解释如下：

1. 在中国，除商业和慈善组织外，公共组织的注册是最高权力的特权，目前这一权力属于国民党及其机构。因此，作为国家最高权力行为授予“SORO”的注册许可是最终且具有决定性的。

2. 通过向中国当局注册，“SORO”获得了具有官方认可法律地位的公共团体的全部权利。上海的俄侨社区现在不是由一个或几个个人代表，而是由一个机构代表——这正是社区一直以来所追求的目标。

3. 俄侨社区获得了一个具有公证职能的机构。理事会依照中国法律并在其职权范围内发出的每一份文件，都具有官方文件的效力，其有效性和合法性只能在法庭上受到质疑。

4. 理事会主席团及其执行官员对其行为承担的责任，与公职人员在其职务范围内行事所承担的责任相同。

随着“SORO”向中国当局注册，该机构总体上的活动

page_data.en:
- 7 -

and of Mr. A. M. Kotenev in particular aroused much comment
and adverse criticism on the part of the opposing group of
the local Russian community represented by the "Russian Emigrants
Committee", which may be briefly summarised as follows:-

1. The "formally inaugurated" "SORO" is another attempt on
the part of one and the same group of unprincipled
politicians to mislead the local Russian community by
staging an institution of a quasi-public character.
Since 1925 when this group challenged the authority of
Mr. V. F. Grosse, former Russian Imperial Consul in
Shanghai, to represent the Russian community, three
similar attempts have proved complete failures:- "The
Committee for the Defence of Rights and Interests of
Russian Community", "The Russian National Community"
and "SORO" - all these ventures were started off with
a great display of pomp but all died a natural death
owing to their uselessness.

2. After a period of over seven years of activity this
group has little, if anything at all, to show as regards
thereal work for the benefit of the community. With
the exception of the military group which joined "SORO"
owing to some misunderstanding, not a single political
or public organization conducting real work, supports
this group. On the other hand, the negative results
of their activity for the past seven years are enormous.
First - desintegration of the community carried out to
the limits, and then its "unification" into "SORO", not
the old "SORO", but another one - with a whip of a foreign
political party as the "unifying element".

3. At the present moment of the national crisis in China
the Kuomintang engaged in the solving of their own vital
problems and subdivided into several factions, has
certainly very little interest for our affairs. It is
hoped that a small group of unprincipled politicians
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

特别是A. M. 科特涅夫先生的活动，引起了以“俄侨委员会”为代表的当地俄侨反对派群体的许多议论和负面批评，简要总结如下：

1. “正式成立”的“SORO”是同一群无原则政客试图通过上演一个 quasi-public 性质的机构来误导当地俄侨社区的又一次尝试。自1925年该团体挑战前俄国驻上海帝国领事V. F. 格罗斯（Grosse）先生代表俄侨社区的权威以来，三次类似的尝试均彻底失败：“俄侨权益保护委员会”、“俄国国民公会”和“SORO”——所有这些举措开始时都大张旗鼓，但都因其无用性而自然消亡。

2. 经过七年多的活动，该团体在为社区谋福利的实际工作方面几乎没有任何成果可展示。除了因某种误解而加入“SORO”的军事团体外，没有一个从事实际工作的政治或公共组织支持该团体。另一方面，他们过去七年活动的负面结果是巨大的。首先是社区的分裂达到了极限，然后是将其“统一”进“SORO”，但不是旧的“SORO”，而是另一个——以外国政党的鞭子作为“统一要素”。

3. 在中国民族危机的当前时刻，国民党忙于解决自身的关键问题并分裂为几个派系，肯定对我们的事务兴趣寥寥。希望这一小撮冒充“俄国公共组织联合理事会”的无原则政客

page_data.en:
- 8 -

posing as the "Council of United Russian Public Organi-
zation" will not succeed in misleading the Kuomintang
into interfering with our small, but so important for
us, domestic affairs. Kotenev's political manipulations
will then come to naught.

4. Russian community in Shanghai although divided into
various organizations has always been loyal towards the
Chinese authorities. Russian organizations here followed
the old traditions of Russian public bodies. Above them
is the Chinese jurisdiction and municipal regulations and
bye-laws. Quite of a sudden Kotenev - a small municipal
employee and an insignificant person in the past, started
a political game on a "big scale" and endeavours to
complicate the situation for the Russian community as
well as for the Chinese authorities by his attempt to
wield power over the Russian community at the hands of
the Kuomintang - a game fraught with very serious and
dangerous consequences for those who will allow themselves
to be misled by the selfish policy of Mr. Kotenev and Co.
What if the left, pro-communist wing of the Kuomintang
will come to power?

Following somebody's instructions, a group of irresponsible
persons endeavour to lead the Russian community somewhere
without first asking their consent".

On April 30, 1933, Mr. A. M. Kotenev tendered his
resignation as chairman of the "Council of United Russian Public
Organization" because of his duties in the Shanghai Municipal
Council. Dr. S. N. Shendrikoff, vice-chairman, was authorised
to act in his place pending an election to be held in the near
future.

On June 1, 1933, Dr. Shendrikoff forwarded to the
Commissioner of Police a copy of the Regulations and Bye-Laws
of "SORO" accompanied by a letter in which it was pointed out
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

不会成功误导国民党干涉我们虽小但对我们至关重要的内部事务。科特涅夫的政治操纵终将化为泡影。

4. 上海的俄侨社区虽然分裂为各种组织，但一直对中国当局保持忠诚。这里的俄国组织遵循俄国公共团体的旧传统。在其之上的是中国司法管辖权和市政规章及细则。突然之间，科特涅夫——过去只是一个小小的市政雇员和无足轻重的人物——开始了一场“大规模”的政治游戏，并试图通过借助国民党之手掌控俄侨社区，使俄侨社区和中国当局的局势复杂化——这场游戏对于那些允许自己被科特涅夫及其同伙的自私政策所误导的人来说，蕴含着非常严重和危险的后果。如果国民党内亲共的左翼掌权怎么办？

“一群不负责任的人遵循某人的指示，试图在未征得俄侨社区同意的情况下将其引向某个方向”。

1933年4月30日，A. M. 科特涅夫先生因其在上海工部局的职责，辞去了“上海俄国公共组织联合理事会”主席一职。副主席S. N. 申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）博士获授权在其位，直至近期举行选举。

1933年6月1日，申德里科夫博士向警务处长转交了“SORO”规章及细则的副本，并附有一封信，信中指出

page_data.en:
- 9 -

that "SORO" is the only one legally instituted Russian public
body at Shanghai entitled to perform acts enumerated in Art.13
of these Regulations. In view of this Dr.Shendrikoff requested
that instructions be issued by the Commissioner to all subordinate
departments and officers that in all cases where Russian
emigrants are required to produce formal identification papers
etc. they must produce same certified or registered by "SORO".
According to our information similar letters were
addressed to various authorities and consulates in Shanghai.
Reference to the Art.13 of the Regulations in question
shows that Dr. Shendrikoff's letter raises the same issue which
has been the subject of controversies between "SORO" and the
"Russian Emigrants Committee", namely - which of the two
organizations should be recognised as the only body representing
the Russian community in Shanghai.
The expression "legally instituted" evidently implies
the fact that "SORO" is registered with the Bureau of Social
Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai as well as that
"SORO" is a body properly elected by the Russian community in
Shanghai, while the Russian Emigrants Committee is considered
by them as a self-appointed body.
In this connection it should be noted that there is,
so far, no reason to believe that the Chinese authorities
consider "SORO" as the only Russian organization which can
exercise the functions enumerated in Art.13 above referred to.
As a matter of fact, they almost invariably refer to the
"Russian Emigrants Committee" whenever they wish to get in
touch with a body more or less representing the interests of
the Russian community in Shanghai.
As regards the assertion that "SORO" is a properly elected
public body, it may be stated that the system according to
which various organizations are represented in "SORO" differs
from ordinary elections in so far as one and the same individual
is allowed to elect representatives into this body from several
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

称“SORO”是上海唯一依法成立的俄罗斯公共机构，有权执行本条例第13条所列之行为。鉴于此，申德里科夫博士（Dr. Shendrikoff）请求警务处处长向所有下属部门和警官发出指令，规定在所有要求俄罗斯侨民出示正式身份证明文件等情况下，他们必须出示经“SORO”认证或登记的文件。据我方掌握的信息，类似的信函已致函上海各当局及领事馆。查阅上述条例第13条可知，申德里科夫博士的信函提出了一个与“SORO”和“俄罗斯侨民委员会”之间争议相同的问题，即这两个组织中哪一个应被承认为代表上海俄罗斯社区的唯一机构。“依法成立”这一表述显然意味着以下事实：“SORO”已在上海特别市社会局注册，且“SORO”是由上海俄罗斯社区正当选举产生的机构，而他们认为俄罗斯侨民委员会是一个自行任命的机构。在此需要指出的是，目前尚无理由相信中国当局将“SORO”视为唯一能够行使上述第13条所列职能的俄罗斯组织。事实上，每当中国当局希望与一个或多或少代表上海俄罗斯社区利益的机构取得联系时，他们几乎无一例外地求助于“俄罗斯侨民委员会”。关于“SORO”是一个经正当选举产生的公共机构这一说法，可以说，“SORO”中各组织的代表产生制度与普通选举不同，因为同一个人被允许同时从几个

page_data.en:
- 10 -

organizations at the same time.

Although statistics are not available regarding
respective total membership of the two rival organizations
and of the neutral group, it is more than questionable that
"SORO" represents the majority of the Russian community in
Shanghai.

In the absence of an authoritative organ which could
organise proper elections in the Russian community and unless
some "force majeure" intervenes, an agreement between the
Russian Emigrants Committee and the "Council of United Russian
Public Organization" seems to be the only manner in which local
Russian organizations can be unified and a body representing
the local Russian community, formed and recognised as such by
the authorities of the three municipalities.

Dr. Shendrikoff's letter to the Commissioner of Police
may be considered as an attempt to bring "force majeure" to bear
pressure in favour of "SORO".

On June 11, 1933, during the course of a meeting of
the "Council of United Russian Public Organization at Shanghai"
the following persons were elected into the Presidium of this
body:-

Dr. S. N. Shendrikoff .................... Chairman
Mr. M. I. Sobludseff ..................... Vice-Chairman
General L. A. Gaffner .................... Vice-Chairman
Mr. S. S. Berkman ........................ Hon.Treasurer
Dr. K. V. Hohlachkin ..................... Hon.Secretary

The offices of "SORO" are at present located at
No.442 Avenue Joffre.

Attached herewith is a list of Russian organizations
which do not belong to the "Council of United Russian Public
Organization at Shanghai" ("SORO").
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

组织中选举代表进入该机构。

虽然目前没有关于这两个对立组织及中立群体各自总成员数的统计数据，但“SORO”是否代表了上海俄罗斯社区的绝大多数人是大可怀疑的。

在缺乏一个能够组织俄罗斯社区进行正当选举的权威机构的情况下，除非出现某种“不可抗力”，否则俄罗斯侨民委员会与“俄罗斯联合公共组织理事会”之间的协议似乎是统一当地俄罗斯组织、形成一个代表当地俄罗斯社区的机构并得到三个租界当局承认的唯一途径。

申德里科夫博士致警务处处长的信函可被视为试图利用“不可抗力”向有利于“SORO”的方向施加压力。

page_data.en:
COPIE

TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN

SO called, "Council of the United Russian Organisations at
Shanghai, which is known to everybody as "SORO", continued to
bluff the people.

As the Russian residents of Shanghai know well that the
"SORO" is a bogue organisation, "SORO" started now a compaign
among the foreign officials and prominent members of the foreign
community by sending a circular letters in which they are claiming
to be a sole, officially recognized institution governing Russians
in Shanghai.

We consider it our duty to explain to our foreign friends
the actual position of the "SORO" and why the majority of the
local Russian organisations and individuals do not recognize the
said shadow institution.

The following facts will explain :

1) "SORO" was organized by Mr. A. M. Koteneff on the money supplied
by notorious Comrade J. G. Debbishman, one of the local agents
of the Soviet Trade Mission.

The money were readily given by Soviets for the purpose of
decomposing local white Russians.

The fact that Koteneff is not white as he claims to be,
could be easily proved by the fact that he is a member of
the "Shanghai Jewish Club", which on 50 o/o consists of Soviet
agents and employees, including such a notorious communists
as J. Brick, L. Brailovsky, M. Brunner, V. Landezen, G. B. Ravee,
etc. etc.

It is not a crime for anybody to be a member of Jewish Club,
but it is a crime for a "white Russian leader" to be a member
of a Club, which consists of Soviet agents.

After Koteneff's has been denounced few months ago, he pretended
to resign from a chairmanship of the "SORO", but in reality
still directing its activities.
page_data.zh:
副本

致有关各方

所谓的“上海俄罗斯联合组织理事会”，即众所周知的“SORO”，继续欺骗民众。

由于上海的俄罗斯居民深知“SORO”是一个虚假组织，“SORO”现在开始通过发送通函，在外籍官员和外籍社区知名人士中开展运动，声称自己是管理上海俄罗斯人的唯一官方认可机构。

我们认为有责任向我们的外国朋友解释“SORO”的实际状况，以及为何大多数当地俄罗斯组织和个人不承认这个影子机构。

以下事实将予以说明：

1) “SORO”是由 A. M. 科捷涅夫先生利用臭名昭著的 J. G. 德比什曼同志提供的资金组织的，后者是苏联贸易代表团的地方代理人之一。

苏维埃为了瓦解当地的白俄分子， readily 提供了这笔资金。

科捷涅夫并不像他声称的那样是白俄，这一事实很容易证明，因为他是“上海犹太俱乐部”的成员，该俱乐部50%的成员是苏联代理人和雇员，包括诸如 J. 布里克、L. 布拉伊洛夫斯基、M. 布伦纳、V. 兰德岑、G. B. 拉维等臭名昭著的共产党人等等。

任何人成为犹太俱乐部的成员并非犯罪，但作为一名“白俄领袖”成为一个由苏联代理人组成的俱乐部的成员则是犯罪。

几个月前科捷涅夫被揭发后，他假装辞去“SORO”主席职务，但实际上仍在指挥其活动。

page_data.en:
COPIE
1

2) Koteneff's successor - Dr. S. SHENDRIKOFF is a notorious
local gambler and his committee consists of such members as
I. Shendrikoff, a socialist, who during the Great War was
expelled to Siberia for anti-militaristic propaganda, both
brothers absconded from Russia during Civil War stealing
funds belonging to Semirek Cossack Government. S. S. Berkman,
another member of "SORO" committee is a Soviet agent and the
member of pro-Soviet "Shanghai Jewish Club".

N.B. However, it must be pointed out that among
the members of the "SORO" there are a few
respected persons, who were misled by the
above mentioned provocateurs.

3) During the existance of "SORO" few notarious local Soviet
agents received emigrants passports through the medium of
these provocateurs.

4) In stead of the claimed unification of the local "white"
Russians, Koteneff and Shendrikoff, leaders of "SORO" do
everything to bring disorder among the local Russian residents.
EVERYBODY, WHO IS STANDING FOR RELIGY, ORDER and FAMILY and
WHO IS AGAINST THE OFFICIAL AND SECRET SOVIET AGENTS AND PROVO-
CATEURS MUST DENOUNCE "SORO", AS IT WAS DENOUNCED BY THE MAJORITY
OF THE LOCAL RUSSIANS.

RUSSIAN RESIDENTS.

（斜向水印：CONSULAR）
page_data.zh:
副本
1

2) 科捷涅夫（Koteneff）的继任者——S. SHENDRIKOFF 博士是一名臭名昭著的本地赌徒，其委员会成员包括 I. Shendrikoff，此人是一名社会主义者，在大战期间因进行反军国主义宣传而被流放到西伯利亚，兄弟二人在俄国内战期间潜逃离开俄国，窃取了属于谢米列奇耶（Semirek）哥萨克政府的资金。“SORO”委员会的另一名成员 S. S. Berkman 是一名苏联特工，也是亲苏的“上海犹太俱乐部”成员。

注：然而，必须指出的是，在“SORO”成员中也有几位受人尊敬的人士，他们被上述挑衅者所误导。

3) 在“SORO”存在期间，几名臭名昭著的本地苏联特工通过这些挑衅者的中介获得了移民护照。

4) 科捷涅夫和申德里科夫（Shendrikoff）作为“SORO”的领导人，非但没有如声称的那样团结本地的“白俄”居民，反而竭尽所能地在本地俄国居民中制造混乱。每一个拥护宗教、秩序和家庭，并反对官方及秘密苏联特工和挑衅者的人，都必须谴责“SORO”，正如大多数本地俄国人所谴责的那样。

俄国居民。

（斜向水印：领事馆）

page_data.en:
MEMORANDUM ON THE "COUNCIL OF UNITED RUSSIAN PUBLIC ORGANIZATIONS
AT SHANGHAI" ("SORO").

The establishing of the Russian emigrants organization
known as the "Council of United Russian Public Organizations at
Shanghai" ("SORO") was an outcome of the so-called re-unification
movement in the local Russian community which was started in
October 1931 following the death of Mr. V. F. Grosse, Chairman
of the "Russian Emigrants Committee".

It will be recalled that since 1920 when the Imperial
Russian Consulate-General in Shanghai was closed by a decree of
the Chinese Government, Mr. Grosse, former Russian Consul-General,
continued to remain in charge of the interests of the local
Russian community on the post of the Assistant Commissioner of
the Bureau for Russian Affairs which was established by the
Chinese Authorities in the premises of the Russian Consulate-
General, No. 1 Whangpoo Road. In 1924 following the recognition
by China of the Government of Soviet Russia the Bureau for Russian
Affairs was closed and the building of the former Russian
Consulate-General was handed over by the Chinese Authorities
to representatives of the Soviet Government.

Mr. Grosse then established, in co-operation with
representatives of local Russian organizations, a public body
under the name of the "Committee for Defense of Rights of Russian
Emigrants". In 1926, however, the authority of Mr. Grosse to
represent the local Russian community was challenged by a group
of Russian organizations. As a result of this disagreement
Mr. Grosse supported by his followers formed another public
body under the name of the "Russian Emigrants Committee" which,
under his chairmanship, continued to exercise the functions of
the administrative centre of the Russian community in Shanghai.
This body has since maintained contact with the Council of
Russian Ex-Ambassadors in Paris.
page_data.zh:
关于“上海俄国公共组织联合会”（“SORO”）的备忘录。

被称为“上海俄国公共组织联合会”（“SORO”）的俄国移民组织的建立，是本地俄国社区所谓重新统一运动的结果，该运动始于1931年10月，即“俄国移民委员会”主席 V. F. Grosse 先生去世之后。

回顾自1920年中国政府下令关闭驻上海俄国总领事馆以来，前俄国总领事 Grosse 先生继续负责本地俄国社区的利益，担任由中国当局在黄浦路1号原俄国总领事馆馆址设立的俄事局助理专员一职。1924年，随着中国承认苏维埃俄国政府，俄事局被关闭，原俄国总领事馆大楼由中国当局移交给苏联政府代表。

随后，Grosse 先生与本地俄国组织代表合作，成立了一个名为“保卫俄国移民权利委员会”的公共机构。然而，1926年，Grosse 先生代表本地俄国社区的权威受到一群俄国组织的挑战。由于这一分歧，Grosse 先生在其支持者的支持下成立了另一个名为“俄国移民委员会”的公共机构，并在其主席领导下，继续行使上海俄国社区行政中心的职能。该机构此后一直与巴黎俄国前大使理事会保持联系。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The opposing faction of the Russian community in
Shanghai was represented by the "Committee for Defense of
Rights of Russian Emigrants" of which Mr. N. I. Ivanoff, former
consular judge, was the Chairman. In 1929 this body was
dissolved and its functions handed over to an organization
entitled the "Russian National Community" of which Captain
N. Y. Fomin was elected Chairman. Organizations under this
name were established in several towns in the Far East by
supporters of General Horvath whom the late Grand Duke Nicolas
appointed the Head of Russian Emigrants in the Far East.

Both the "Russian Emigrants Committee" and the
"Russian National Community" were instituted with the object
of carrying out similar functions. Although the former body
undoubtedly predominated, this state of affairs could not be
considered either satisfactory or normal.

On October 23, 1931, at a meeting of the Russian
Juridical Society the situation in the Russian community in
connection with the death of Mr. Grosse was discussed and it
was unanimously resolved to recommend that the legal representation
of the Russian Community should rest with a special neutral body
which will take charge of the work of registration of the Russian
Community, render legal assistance, issue and certify documents,
certificates of births, deaths etc. This resolution was
communicated to all existing Russian public organizations in
Shanghai and published in the local foreign and Russian press.

On October 26, 1931, a meeting of representatives of
some 30 Russian organizations, convened at the initiative of
the "Russian National Community", was held in the premises of
the Russian Ex-Officers Club, 246 Route Vallon, to discuss the
question of legal and business representation of the Russian
Community. The resolution of the Russian Juridical Society
was passed and the "Russian National Community" was authorised
to enter into negotiations with the "Russian Emigrants Committee"
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

上海俄国社区的反对派由“保卫俄国移民权利委员会”代表，前领事法官 N. I. Ivanoff 先生担任该委员会主席。1929年，该机构解散，其职能移交给一个名为“俄国民族共同体”的组织，N. Y. Fomin 上尉当选为主席。在霍尔瓦特将军（General Horvath）的支持者推动下，远东几个城镇也建立了同名组织，已故尼古拉大公曾任命霍尔瓦特将军为远东俄国移民首领。

“俄国移民委员会”和“俄国民族共同体”的设立目的均在于履行类似的职能。虽然前者无疑占主导地位，但这种状况既不能令人满意，也不正常。

1931年10月23日，在俄国法律协会的一次会议上，讨论了因 Grosse 先生去世而引发的俄国社区局势，会议一致通过决议，建议俄国社区的法律代表权应归属于一个特殊的中立机构，该机构将负责俄国社区的登记工作，提供法律援助，签发和认证文件、出生证明、死亡证明等。该决议已传达给上海所有现有的俄国公共组织，并在本地外文和俄文报刊上发表。

1931年10月26日，由“俄国民族共同体”发起，约30个俄国组织的代表会议在华伦路（Route Vallon）246号俄国退役军官俱乐部举行，讨论俄国社区的法律和商业代表权问题。会议通过了俄国法律协会的决议，并授权“俄国民族共同体”与由前上海俄国副领事 Metzler 先生领导的“俄国移民委员会”进行谈判，

page_data.en:
- 3 -

headed by Mr. Metzler, former Russian Vice-Consul in Shanghai,
with a view to establishing a new body on the lines indicated
in the above resolution. As a result of these negotiations
it was announced at the public meeting of representatives of
various Russian organizations held on November 12, 1931, that
a preliminary agreement had been reached between the two opposing
factions. A committee was then elected to compile the plan of
the constitution of the body as well as the order of its elections.

However, after several meetings of the committee it
became evident that the representatives of the two rival
organizations could not agree on certain points and, consequently,
negotiations were broken off, following which the "Russian
National Community" decided to carry on the work of unification
in co-operation with the so-called "third element" - organizations
and individuals who did not belong to either of the two
organizations referred to above. On January 17, 1932,
representatives of the organizations supporting this scheme
held a meeting during the course of which it was decided to
call the new organization "The Council of United Russian Public
Organizations at Shanghai", and a set of regulations was submitted
and approved. The following were then elected members of the
Presidium of the Council:-

Mr.A.M.Kotenev
Attached to the Secretariat of the S.M.C. - Chairman

Captain M.Y.Fomin
Chairman of the "Russian National Community" Vice-Chairman

Mr.V.I.Korniloff
Manager of the "Compagnie Francaise de
Commerce en Chine", 776 Avenue Joffre. - Vice-Chairman

Dr.A.V.Tarle
Chairman of the Russian Medical
Practitioners Society. - Honorary Secretary

Mr.V.A.Ryloff
Proprietor of a Haberdashery Store,
No. 413 Avenue Joffre. - Honorary Treasurer

As the Russian Emigrants Committee continued to
function independently of the newly formed body and there [涂改痕迹]

（左侧页边批注：Omit!）
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

旨在按照上述决议指示的方针建立一个新机构。经过这些谈判，在1931年11月12日举行的各俄国组织代表公开会议上宣布，两个对立派别之间已达成初步协议。随后选举产生了一个委员会，负责起草该机构的章程草案以及选举程序。

然而，经过委员会的几次会议后，显然两个 rival 组织的代表在某些问题上无法达成一致，因此谈判破裂。随后，“俄国民族共同体”决定与所谓的“第三势力”——即不属于上述两个组织的组织和个人——合作，继续开展统一工作。1932年1月17日，支持该方案的各组织代表举行会议，会上决定将新组织命名为“上海俄国公共组织联合会”，并提交并通过了一套规章。随后选举产生以下人员为理事会主席团成员：

A.M. Kotenev 先生
附属于工部局秘书处 - 主席

M.Y. Fomin 上尉
“俄国民族共同体”主席 - 副主席

V.I. Korniloff 先生
“在华法国商业公司”经理，霞飞路776号 - 副主席

A.V. Tarle 博士
俄国医师协会主席 - 名誉秘书

V.A. Ryloff 先生
杂货店店主，霞飞路413号 - 名誉司库

由于俄国移民委员会继续独立于新成立的机构运作，并且 [涂改痕迹]

（左侧页边批注：省略！）

page_data.en:
- 4 -
several other organizations which prefer to remain "neutral",
it is evident that the re-unification movement had proved a
failure and that, therefore, the name of the "Council of United
Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai" is rather misleading.
Both sides have much to say in explanation of the
failure to come to an agreement and to put an end to the
deplorable state of dissension in which Russian public
organizations have been for the past several years. To an
impartial observer, however, it seems that the element of
personal antagonism and distrust among a limited number of
persons - result of several years of controversies - has played
an unduly prominent part in the negotiations. On the other
hand, lack of interest in public affairs on the part of the
majority of the local Russian community may account for the
fact that sufficient pressure has not been brought to bear on
the rival parties in order to compel them to come to an
understanding. It is believed also that there are among
the Russian community some Soviet "agents-provocateurs" whose
activity is directed towards the disorganizing the ranks of
the "Whites".
Both the Russian Emigrants Committee and the "SORO"
claim to be supported by a number of Russian public organizations.
It must be said, however, that of these numerous organizations
comparatively few are engaged in active work among their
nationals. The majority of them can be described as groups
of persons unified by their connections in the past or common
interests, and their activity is mostly limited to mutual aid.
There are also some organizations with high sounding titles
which exist only on paper and whose membership is barely
sufficient to fill vacancies in their "governing boards".
A case which recently came to the notice of the Municipal
Police tends to indicate that the two rival bodies, being
perhaps too eager in their quest of supporters, do not exercise
page_data.zh:
- 4 -
还有其他几个组织倾向于保持“中立”，显然重新统一运动已经失败，因此，“上海俄国公共组织联合会”这一名称具有相当的误导性。双方对于未能达成协议以及结束过去几年俄国公共组织所处的可悲分裂状态有很多解释。然而，对于 impartial 观察者来说，似乎有限人数之间的个人敌意和不信任——这是多年争论的结果——在谈判中发挥了过分突出的作用。另一方面，本地俄国社区大多数人对公共事务缺乏兴趣，这可能解释了为何未能对 rival 各方施加足够的压力以迫使他们达成谅解。人们还认为，俄国社区中存在一些苏联“挑衅特工”，其活动旨在瓦解“白俄”队伍的阵线。
俄国移民委员会和“SORO”都声称得到许多俄国公共组织的支持。然而，必须指出的是，在这些众多组织中，只有相对较少的组织在其同胞中开展积极工作。大多数组织可以描述为由过去的联系或共同利益联合起来的人群团体，其活动主要局限于互助。还有一些组织拥有响亮的头衔，但仅存在于纸面上，其成员数量 barely 足以填补其“管理委员会”的空缺。最近引起工部局警务处注意的一个案例表明，这两个 rival 机构也许过于急切地寻求支持者，因而没有对

page_data.en:
- 5 -

sufficient control over the activities of some of organizations
of the latter types- Chairman of one of such bogus organization
entrusted the task of collecting donations in Shanghai and other
cities in China to......a couple of well known shoplifters, who
subsequently were detained by the police of the French Concession
in Canton. (File No 4842)

In the beginning of February 1932 the "Council of
United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai" established
its offices at No.39 Avenue Edward VII, and thus a new period
in the history of public life of the local Russian community was
opened.

Paragraph 3 of the "Regulations and Bye-Laws for the
Council of United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai" reads
as follows:-

"The Council adheres in furtherance of its
"objects and aims to the laws of the present
"Republic of China as well as to the
"administrative and municipal regulations
"in force in the International Settlement
"and French Concession of Shanghai".

In accordance with the above, a petition was submitted
to the Chinese authorities on June 30, 1932, requesting their
permission for the establishment and registration of the "Council
of United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai". This petition
was signed by 34 members of the council and was forwarded through
the medium of Dr. John C. H. Wu (Adviser to the Shanghai Municipal
Council and legal adviser of "SORO") to the Executive Committee of
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters.

On August 4, 1932, a reply was received from the local
Kuomintang Headquarters to the effect that permission for the
registration of the new body had been granted.

Taking into consideration that some of the regulations
governing the activity of Chinese public organizations are not
applicable within the territories of the foreign settlements and
may hinder the activity of the "Council of United Russian Public
Organizations", the legal adviser of the Council applied to the
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

后一类某些组织的活动进行充分控制——其中一个虚假组织的主席委托......几名众所周知的扒手在上海和中国其他城市募集捐款，这些人随后被广州法租界警方拘留。（档案号 4842）

1932年2月初，“上海俄国公共组织联合会”在爱德华七世路39号设立了办事处，从而开启了本地俄国社区公共生活历史的新时期。

《上海俄国公共组织联合会规章及附则》第3条规定如下：

“本会在推进其目标
和宗旨时，遵守现行
中华民国法律，以及
上海公共租界和法租界
现行的行政和市政规章”。

根据上述规定，1932年6月30日向中国当局提交了一份请愿书，请求批准建立并注册“上海俄国公共组织联合会”。该请愿书由理事会34名成员签署，并通过吴经熊博士（上海公共租界工部局顾问及“SORO”法律顾问）转呈至上海特别区国民党党部执行委员会。

1932年8月4日，收到本地国民党党部的回复，称已批准该新机构的注册。

考虑到管辖中国公共组织活动的某些规章不适用于外国租界领土内，并可能阻碍“上海俄国公共组织联合会”的活动，该理事会的法律顾问向

page_data.en:
- 6 -

same authorities for a special certificate of registration. In
a reply dated October 6, 1932, the Executive Committee of the
Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters informed the
petitioners that pending the promulgation by the Central Committee
of the Kuomintang of regulations governing the establishment of
Foreign Residents Associations, no special certificate of
registration (diploma) can be issued.

On October 18 and 19 the following official notification
which was drawn up by Dr. Wu and approved "by the authorities
concerned", was published in the "Chen Pao", organ of the Kuomintang,
the "Min Pao" and the "Shun Pao":-

"The United Russian Organization in Shanghai
hereby notifies the public of the following:-
Since some time recently the abovementioned
organization has been preparing for its formal
inauguration. At present, in compliance with
and by virtue of orders of the Shanghai Special
District Kuomintang Headquarters, dated August
4 and October 8, 1932 respectively, granting
permission for the establishment (inauguration),
a general meeting will be held at 4 p.m. on
Sunday November 6 at No.39 Avenue Edward VII
for the purpose of the formal inauguration of
this organization. The public is hereby
specially notified".

Considering that the registration with the Chinese
authorities has introduced the Council into a new phase of its
activity, and with a view to facilitating the unification of all
Russian organizations in Shanghai into this body, the presidium
of the Council decided to resign from office and to invite all
organizations,which did not belong to the "SORO" group, to send
representatives to the meeting on November 6 for the purpose of
election of a new presidium in accordance with the statute of
"SORO". A notification to this effect was published in local
Russian newspapers on October 20.

On November 6, at a meeting attended by 37 of the total
number of 54 members of the"Council of United Russian Public
Organizations", the formal inauguration of this body took place,
whereupon the following persons were elected into the presidium:-
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

向同一当局申请特别注册证书。在1932年10月6日的复函中，上海特别区国民党党部执行委员会告知请愿人，鉴于国民党中央委员会尚未颁布关于建立外侨协会的规章，因此无法颁发特别注册证书（文凭）。

10月18日和19日，由吴博士起草并经“有关当局”批准的以下官方通告刊登在国民党机关报《晨报》、《民报》和《顺报》上：

“上海俄国联合组织特此向公众通告如下：
近来，上述组织一直在筹备其正式成立事宜。目前，遵照并依据上海特别区国民党党部分别于1932年8月4日和10月8日下达的批准成立（ inaugurated ）的命令，定于11月6日星期日下午4时，在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）39号举行大会，旨在正式成立本组织。特此专门通告公众。”

鉴于向中国当局注册使工部局进入了一个新的活动阶段，并且为了促进上海所有俄国组织统一纳入该机构，工部局主席团决定辞职，并邀请所有不属于“SORO”（上海俄国联合组织）团体的组织派代表参加11月6日的会议，以便根据“SORO”章程选举新的主席团。10月20日，当地俄文报纸刊登了以此为目的的通知。

11月6日，在“俄国公共组织联合委员会”54名成员中的37人出席的会议上，该机构正式成立，随后选举下列人员进入主席团：

page_data.en:
- 7 -

Mr. A. M. Kotenev .................... Chairman
Captain N. G. Fomin               Vice-Chairman
Dr. S. N. Shendrikoff             Vice-Chairman
Dr. K. V. Hohlachkin              Hon. Secretary
Mr. S. S. Berkman                 Hon. Treasurer

It must be mentioned that out of 19 organizations not belonging to "SORO" only one - a group of Russian emigrants of Jewish nationality - sent its representatives to the above meeting, the other organizations having declined the invitation for various reasons.

In compliance with Chinese law the minutes of this meeting together with the statute of the new organization will be submitted to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Head-quarters and to the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to be recorded in the registers of these institutions.

The significance of the registration of "SORO" with the Chinese authorities was explained by Mr.A.M.Kotenev as follows:-

1. The registration of public organizations in China, other than commercial and charitable, is a prerogative of the Supreme Power which at present belongs to the Kuomintang and its organs. Thus, the permission for registration granted to "SORO", as an act of the Supreme Power of the country, is therefore final and conclusive.

2. By the fact of registration with the Chinese authorities "SORO" has acquired the full rights of a public body with officially recognised legal status. The Russian community in Shanghai is now represented not by one or several individuals, but by an institution - to which aim the community's aspirations have been directed at all times.

3. The Russian community has acquired an organ with notary functions. Every document issued by the Council in conformity with the Chinese laws and within the Council's competence, has the force of an official document, of which the validity and lawfulness can be disputed only in courts.
page_data.zh:
- 7 -

A. M. Kotenev 先生 .................... 主席
N. G. Fomin 上尉               副主席
S. N. Shendrikoff 博士             副主席
K. V. Hohlachkin 博士              荣誉秘书
S. S. Berkman 先生                 荣誉司库

必须指出，在不属于“SORO”的19个组织中，只有一个——犹太裔俄国移民群体——派代表参加了上述会议，其他组织因各种原因拒绝了邀请。

根据中国法律，本次会议的会议纪要以及新组织的章程将提交至上海特别区国民党党部和上海特别市社会局，以便在这些机构的登记册中备案。

A.M. Kotenev 先生对“SORO”向中国当局注册的意义解释如下：

1. 在中国，除商业和慈善组织外，公共组织的注册是最高权力的特权，而目前这一权力属于国民党及其机构。因此，作为国家最高权力行为授予“SORO”的注册许可，是最终且具有决定性的。

2. 通过向中国当局注册，“SORO”获得了具有官方认可法律地位的公共团体的全部权利。上海的俄国社群现在不再由一个或几个人代表，而是由一个机构来代表——这正是该社群一直以来所追求的目标。

3. 俄国社群获得了一个具有公证职能的机构。委员会依照中国法律并在其职权范围内签发的每一份文件，都具有官方文件的效力，其有效性和合法性只能在法庭上受到质疑。

page_data.en:
- 8 -

4. The responsibility of the presidium of the Council and of
its executive officers for their acts is the same as the
responsibility of public officers for acts done in their
official capacity.

In connection with the registration of "SORO" with the
Chinese authorities the activity of this body generally and of
Mr. A.M.Kotenev in particular has aroused much comment and adverse
criticism on the part of the opposing group of the local Russian
community represented by the "Russian Emigrants Committee", which
may be briefly summarised as follows:-

1. The "formally inaugurated" "SORO" is another attempt on the
part of one and the same group of unprincipled politicians
to mislead the local Russian community by staging an
institution of a quasi-public character. Since 1925 when
this group challenged the authority of Mr. V. F. Grosse,
former Russian Imperial Consul in Shanghai, to represent
the Russian community, three similar attempts have proved
complete failures:- "The Committee for the Defence of Rights
and Interests of Russian Community", "The Russian National
Community" and "SORO" - all these ventures were started off
with a great display of pomp but all died a natural death
owing to their uselessness.

2. After a period of over seven years of activity this group
has little, if anything at all, to show as regards the real
work for the benefit of the community. With the exception
of the military group which joined "SORO" owing to some
misunderstanding, not a single political or public organi-
zation conducting real work, supports this group. On the
other hand, the negative results of their activity for the
past seven years are enormous. First - desintegration of
the community carried out to the limits, and then its
"unification" into "SORO", not the old "SORO", but another -
one - with a whip of a foreign political party as the
"unifying element".
page_data.zh:
- 8 -

4. 委员会主席团及其执行官员对其行为承担的责任，与公职人员在其职务范围内行事所承担的责任相同。

随着“SORO”向中国当局注册，该机构的一般活动，特别是 A.M. Kotenev 先生的活动，引起了当地俄国社群中由“俄国移民委员会”代表的反对派群体的诸多议论和负面批评，简要总结如下：

1. “正式成立”的“SORO”是同一群无原则政客试图通过策划一个 quasi-public（准公共）性质的机构来误导当地俄国社群的又一次尝试。自1925年该群体挑战前沙俄驻上海总领事 V. F. Grosse 先生代表俄国社群的权威以来，三次类似的尝试均彻底失败：“俄国社群权利与利益保护委员会”、“俄国民族社群”和“SORO”——所有这些举措开始时都大张旗鼓，但都因其无用性而自然消亡。

2. 经过七年多的活动，该群体在为社群谋福利的实际工作方面几乎没有任何成果可展示。除了因某种误解而加入“SORO”的军事团体外，没有一个从事实际工作的政治或公共组织支持该群体。另一方面，他们过去七年活动的负面结果是巨大的。首先是社群分裂到了极致，然后是将其“统一”进“SORO”，但这不是旧的“SORO”，而是另一个——以外国政党的鞭子作为“统一要素”的“SORO”。

page_data.en:
- 9 -

3. At the present moment of the national crisis in China
the Kuomintang engaged in the solving of their own vital
problems and subdivided into several factions, has certainly
very little interest for our affairs. It is hoped that a
small group of unprincipled politicians posing as the
"Council of United Russian Public Organizations" will not
succeed in misleading the Kuomintang into interfering with
our small, but so important for us, domestic affairs.
Kotenev's political manipulations will then come to naught.
4. Russian community in Shanghai although divided into various
organizations has always been loyal towards the Chinese
authorities. Russian organizations here followed the old
traditions of Russian public bodies. Above them is the
Chinese jurisdiction and municipal regulations and bye-
laws. Quite of a sudden Kotenev - a small municipal
employee and an insignificant person in the past, started
a political game on a "big scale" and endeavours to
complicate the situation for the Russian community as
well as for the Chinese authorities by his attempt to
wield power over the Russian community at the hands of
the Kuomintang - a game fraught with very serious and
dangerous consequences for those who will allow themselves
to be misled by the selfish policy of Mr. Kotenev and Co.
What if the left, pro-communist wing of the Kuomintang will
come to power?
Following somebody's instructions, a group of irresponsible
persons endeavour to lead the Russian community somewhere
without first asking their consent."

On April 30, 1932, Mr. A.M.Kotenev tendered his
resignation as chairman of the "Council of United Russian Public
Organizations" because of his duties in the Shanghai Municipal
Council. Dr.S.N.Shendrikoff, vice-chairman, was authorised to
act in his place pending an election to be held in the near future.
page_data.zh:
- 9 -

3. 在目前中国民族危机的时刻，忙于解决自身 vital problems（生死攸关的问题）并分裂为几个派系的国民党，肯定对我们的事务兴趣寥寥。希望这一小撮自称“俄国公共组织联合委员会”的无原则政客不会成功误导国民党干涉我们虽小但对我们至关重要的内部事务。届时，Kotenev 的政治操纵将化为泡影。
4. 上海的俄国社群虽然分裂为各种组织，但一直对中国当局保持忠诚。这里的俄国组织遵循俄国公共团体的旧传统。在其之上是中国司法管辖权和市政规章及细则。突然之间，Kotenev——过去的一名小市政雇员和无足轻重的人物——开始了一场“大规模”的政治游戏，并试图通过借助国民党之手掌控俄国社群的权力，使俄国社群和中国当局的局势复杂化——这场游戏对于那些允许自己被 Kotenev 及其同伙的自私政策所误导的人来说，蕴含着非常严重和危险的后果。如果国民党内亲共的左翼掌权怎么办？
一群不负责任的人遵循某人的指示，试图在未征得同意的情况下将俄国社群引向某个方向。”

1932年4月30日，A.M. Kotenev 先生因其在上海工部局的职责，辞去了“俄国公共组织联合委员会”主席一职。副主席 S.N. Shendrikoff 博士获授权在其位，直至近期举行选举。

page_data.en:
- 10 -

On June 1, 1933, Dr. Shendrikoff forwarded to the
Commissioner of Police a copy of the Regulations and Bye-Laws
of "SORO" accompanied by a letter in which it was pointed out
that "SORO" is the only one legally instituted Russian public
body at Shanghai entitled to perform acts enumerated in Art.13
of these Regulations. In view of this Dr. Shendrikoff requested
that instructions be issued by the Commissioner to all subordinate
departments and officers that in all cases where Russian emigrants
are required to produce formal identification papers etc. they
must produce same certified or registered by "SORO".

According to our information similar letters were
addressed to various authorities and consulates in Shanghai.

Reference to the Art. 13 of the Regulations in question
shows that Dr. Shendrikoff's letter raises the same issue
which has been the subject of controversies between "SORO" and the
"Russian Emigrants Committee", namely - which of the two
organizations should be recognised as the only body representing
the Russian community in Shanghai.

The expression "legally instituted" evidently implies
the fact that "SORO" is registered with the Bureau of Social
Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai as well as that
"SORO" is a body properly elected by the Russian community in
Shanghai, while the Russian Emigrants Committee is considered
by them as a self-appointed body.

In this connection it should be noted that there is,
so far, no reason to believe that the Chinese authorities consider
"SORO" as the only Russian organization which can exercise the
functions enumerated in Art.13 above referred to. As a matter
of fact, they almost invariably refer to the "Russian Emigrants
Committee" whenever they wish to get in touch with a body more
or less representing the interests of the Russian community in
Shanghai.

As regards the assertion that "SORO" is a properly elected public
body, it may be stated that the system according to which various
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

1933年6月1日，Shendrikoff 博士向警务处处长转交了“SORO”的规章和细则副本，并附有一封信，信中指出“SORO”是上海唯一合法成立的俄国公共团体，有权执行这些规章第13条所列的行为。鉴于此，Shendrikoff 博士请求警务处处长向下属各部门和官员发出指令，规定在所有要求俄国移民出示正式身份证明文件等情况下，必须出示经“SORO”认证或注册的文件。

据我们所知，类似的信函也寄给了上海的各种当局和领事馆。

查阅上述规章的第13条显示，Shendrikoff 博士的信函提出了同一个问题，这也是“SORO”与“俄国移民委员会”之间争议的焦点，即——这两个组织中哪一个应被承认为代表上海俄国社群的唯一机构。

“合法成立”这一表述显然意味着“SORO”已在上海特别市社会局注册，并且“SORO”是由上海俄国社群正当选举产生的机构，而他们则认为俄国移民委员会是一个自我任命的机构。

在此方面应注意，截至目前，没有理由相信中国当局认为“SORO”是唯一可以行使上述第13条所列职能的俄国组织。事实上，每当他们希望与或多或少代表上海俄国社群利益的机构取得联系时，他们几乎总是求助于“俄国移民委员会”。

至于声称“SORO”是一个经正当选举产生的公共团体，可以说，各种

page_data.en:
- 11 -

organizations are represented in "SORO" differs from ordinary
elections in so far as one and the same individual is allowed
to elect representatives into this body from several organizations
at the same time.

Although statistics are not available regarding
respective total membership of the two rival organizations
and of the neutral group, it is more than questionable that
"SORO" represents the majority of the Russian community in
Shanghai.

In the absence of an authoritative organ which could
organize proper elections in the Russian community and unless
some "force majeure" intervenes, an agreement between the
Russian Emigrants Committee and the "Council of United Russian
Public Organizations" seems to be the only manner in which local
Russian organizations can be unified and a body representing
the local Russian community, formed and recognised as such by
the authorities of the three municipalities.

Dr. Shendrikoff's letter to the Commissioner of Police
may be considered as an attempt to bring "force majeure" to bear
pressure in favour of "SORO".

On June 11, 1933, during the course of a meeting of
the "Council of United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai"
the following persons were elected into the Presidium of this
body:-

Dr. S. M. Shendrikoff .................... Chairman
Mr. M. I. Schludaeff ..................... Vice-Chairman
General L. A. Gaffner .................... Vice-Chairman
Mr. S. S. Berkman ........................ Hon. Treasurer
Dr. K. V. Hohlachkin ..................... Hon. Secretary

The offices of "SORO" are at present located at No. 442
Avenue Joffre.

Attached herewith is a list of Russian organizations
which do not belong to the "Council of United Russian Public
Organization at Shanghai" ("SORO").
page_data.zh:
- 11 -

组织在“SORO”中的代表制度与普通选举不同，因为同一个人被允许同时从多个组织中选举代表进入该机构。

虽然缺乏关于两个对立组织及中立群体各自总成员数的统计数据，但“SORO”代表上海俄国社群多数这一说法是非常值得怀疑的。

在缺乏能够组织俄国社群进行正当选举的权威机构的情况下，除非发生某些“不可抗力”，否则俄国移民委员会与“俄国公共组织联合委员会”之间的协议似乎是统一当地俄国组织、形成一个代表当地俄国社群的机构并获得三个租界当局承认的唯一方式。

Shendrikoff 博士致警务处处长的信函可被视为试图利用“不可抗力”向有利于“SORO”的方向施加压力。

1933年6月11日，在“上海俄国公共组织联合委员会”会议期间，选举下列人员进入该机构的主席团：

S. M. Shendrikoff 博士 .................... 主席
M. I. Schludaeff 先生 ..................... 副主席
L. A. Gaffner 将军 .................... 副主席
S. S. Berkman 先生 ........................ 荣誉司库
K. V. Hohlachkin 博士 ..................... 荣誉秘书

“SORO”的办事处目前位于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）442号。

随函附上不属于“上海俄国公共组织联合委员会”（“SORO”）的俄国组织名单。

page_data.en:
TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN:

So called, "Council of the United Russian Organizations of
Shanghai, which is known to everybody as "SORO", continued to bluff the people.
As the Russian residents of Shanghai know well that the "SORO" is a bogus organization, SORO started now a campaign among the foreign officials and prominent members of the foreign community by sending a circular letters, in which they are claiming to a sole, officially recognized, institution governing Russians in Shanghai.
We consider it our duty to explain to our foreign friends the actual position of the "SORO" and why the majority of the local Russian organizations and individuals do not recognize the said shadow institution.
The following facts will explain:

1) "SORO" was organized by Mr.A.M.KOTHEWY on the money supplied by notorious Comrade J.C.KUBISHKIN, one of the local agents of the Soviet Trade Mission.
The money were readily given by Soviets for the purpose of decomposing local white Russians.
The fact that KOTHEWY is not white as he claims to be, could be easily proved by the fact that he is a member of the "SHANGHAI JEWISH CLUB", which so far consists of Soviet agents and employees, including such a notorious communists as J.BAIGL, L.BAILOVSKY, M.BECKER, V.LAPKINE, G.S. HAYES, etc.,etc...
It is not a crime for anybody to be a member of Jewish Club, but it is a crime for a "white Russian leader" to be a member of a Club, which consists of Soviet agents.
After KOTHEWY's has been denounced few months ago, he pretended to resign from a chairmanship of the "SORO", but in reality still directing its activities.

2) Kotewy's successor - Mr.S.SHEDRIKOFF is a notorious local gambler and his committee consists of such members as I.SHEDRIKOFF, a socialist, who during the Great War was expelled to Siberia for antimilitaristic propaganda, both brothers absconded from Russia during Civil War stealing funds belonging to Semirech Cossack Government. J.S.Berman, another member of "SORO" committee is a Soviet agent and the member of pro-Soviet "Shanghai Jewish Club".

Note: However, it must be pointed out that among the members of the "SORO" there are few respected persons, who were misled by the above mentioned provocateurs.

3) During the existence of "SORO" few notorious local Soviet agents received emigrants passports through the medium of these provocateurs.

4) In stead of the claimed unification of the local "white" Russians, KOTHEWY and SHEDRIKOFF, leaders of "SORO" do everything to bring disorder among the local Russian residents.

EVERYBODY, WHO IS STANDING FOR BELIEF, ORDER and FAMILY and WHO IS AGAINST THE OFFICIAL AND SECRET SOVIET AGENTS AND PROVOCATEURS MUST DENOUNCE "SORO", AS IT WAS DENOUNCED BY THE MAJORITY OF THE LOCAL RUSSIANS.

RUSSIAN RESIDENTS.

（签名）
（签名）
page_data.zh:
致有关各方：

所谓“上海俄罗斯组织联合会”，即众所周知的“SORO”，继续欺骗民众。鉴于上海俄籍居民深知“SORO”是一个虚假组织，该组织现在开始向外国官员及外侨社区知名人士发起宣传攻势，向他们发送通函，声称其是管理上海俄籍居民的唯一的、经官方认可的机构。

我们认为有责任向我们的外国朋友说明“SORO”的真实情况，并解释为何大多数本地俄罗斯组织和个人不承认这个影子机构。

以下事实将予以说明：

1) “SORO”由 A.M. KOTHEWY 先生利用臭名昭著的同志 J.C. KUBISHKIN 提供的资金组建，后者是苏联贸易代表团的地方代理人之一。苏维埃方面 readily（原文如此）提供资金，旨在瓦解当地的白俄群体。KOTHEWY 并非如他所声称的那样是白俄人，这一事实很容易通过他是“上海犹太俱乐部”成员这一点得到证明，该俱乐部迄今为止由苏联代理人和雇员组成，其中包括 J. BAIGL、L. BAILOVSKY、M. BECKER、V. LAPKINE、G.S. HAYES 等臭名昭著的共产主义者。任何人成为犹太俱乐部的成员并非犯罪，但一名“白俄领袖”成为一个由苏联代理人组成的俱乐部的成员则是犯罪。在几个月前 KOTHEWY 被揭发后，他假装辞去“SORO”主席职务，但实际上仍在指挥其活动。

2) Kotewy 的继任者 S. SHEDRIKOFF 先生是一名当地臭名昭著的赌徒，其委员会成员包括 I. SHEDRIKOFF，此人是一名社会主义者，在大战期间因反军国主义宣传被流放至西伯利亚，兄弟二人在内战期间窃取属于谢米列奇耶（Semirech）哥萨克政府的资金后逃离俄国。“SORO”委员会的另一名成员 J.S. Berman 是一名苏联代理人，也是亲苏的“上海犹太俱乐部”成员。

注：然而，必须指出的是，在“SORO”成员中也有少数受人尊敬的人士，他们被上述挑衅者所误导。

3) 在“SORO”存在期间，少数当地臭名昭著的苏联代理人通过这些挑衅者的媒介获得了移民护照。

4) 与其声称的统一当地“白”俄人的目标相反，“SORO”的领导人 KOTHEWY 和 SHEDRIKOFF 竭尽所能在当地俄籍居民中制造混乱。

所有拥护信仰、秩序和家庭，并反对官方及秘密苏联代理人和挑衅者的人，必须像大多数当地俄国人那样谴责“SORO”。

俄籍居民。

（签名）
（签名）

Sir,

Shanghai, June 1st 1933.-

Sir,

Pursuant to the provisions of the Regulations and
Bye-laws for the Council of the United Russian Public
Organisation (S.O.R.O.) at Shanghai duly confirmed and
registered by the respective Chinese authorities, I have
the honour to forward to you a copy of these regulati-
ons.

In view of the fact that the United Russian Public
Organisation is the only legally instituted Russian pu-
blic body at Shanghai entitled to perform acts enumerated
in Art. 13 of these Regulations, I am directed by its
Council to address you with the request that instructions
be given to all your subordinate departments and officers
that in cases when persons of Russian nationality, non-
citizens of the Union of the Soviet Socialist Republics
(emigrants), are concerned or required to produce formal
identification papers, certificates or documents regard-
ing their educational qualification, family and property
standing or past services in Russia they must produce
same certified or registered by this Council.
