page_data.en:
I. Objects and Aims of the Council.
1. The Council of the United Russian Public Organisation is established for the purpose of unification and co-ordination of activities of the existing Russian Public Bodies in Shanghai and is a body representing legal and business interests of the Russians in Shanghai who are not citizens of the Union of the Soviet Socialist Republics.
2. The Council is also established for the purpose of rendering assistance to the lawful authorities in the maintenance of peace, order and good government in the territory of Shanghai, when called upon for such assistance.

II. Means of Realisation of Objects and Aims of the Council.
3. The Cuncil adheres in furtherance of the above aims and objects to the laws of the present Republic of China as well as to the administrative and municipal regulations in force in the International Settlement and French Concession of Shanghai.
4. The Council deliberates and decides, within the limits of its competence, ONLY questions of public and business nature, PRIVATE AND GENERAL, affecting the Russian Emigrants' Colony at Shanghai, representing it in all phases of local public life.
5. The Council, and its Chairman may enter into communication with Chinese, Foreign and Russian (non-Soviet) public institutions and private persons in all cases affecting the Council and the Russian Colony in Shanghai, when required in accordance with these Regulations.
6. The Council may enter into compacts with Russian Organisations existing outside Shanghai and pursuing analogous aims.

III. Composition of the Council.
7. The Council is composed of the representatives of Russian Emigrants' Public Organisations and Associations now existant as well as of those to be formed in the future, of national, scientific, professional, commercial, industrial, social and business character which shall be represented on the Council in accordance with the following scheme:—
(a) Organisations of less than 25 members, except as here-after mentioned, by their Chairman or his deputy.

— 1 —
page_data.zh:
一、理事会的宗旨和目标。
1. 俄罗斯公共联合组织理事会的成立旨在统一和协调上海现有俄罗斯公共团体的活动，它是代表在上海的非苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟公民的俄籍人士的法律和商业利益的机构。
2. 理事会的成立亦旨在应召协助合法当局维持上海地区的和平、秩序和良好治理。

二、实现理事会宗旨和目标的手段。
3. 理事会为促进上述宗旨和目标，遵守中华民国现行法律以及上海公共租界和法租界现行的行政和市政法规。
4. 理事会在其职权范围内，仅审议和决定影响上海俄裔流亡者社区的公共和商业性质、私人和一般性问题，并在当地公共生活的各个方面代表该社区。
5. 在根据本章程规定需要时，理事会及其主席可就涉及理事会和上海俄裔社区的所有事项，与中国、外国和俄罗斯（非苏维埃）公共机构及私人进行联络。
6. 理事会可与上海境外追求类似目标的俄罗斯组织达成协议。

三、理事会的组成。
7. 理事会由目前存在的以及未来将成立的具有民族、科学、专业、商业、工业、社会和商务性质的俄罗斯流亡者公共组织和协会的代表组成，这些代表将按照以下方案在理事会中拥有席位：—
(a) 成员少于25人的组织，除下文提及者外，由其主席或副主席代表。

— 1 —

page_data.en:
(b) Organisations of from 25 to 100 members by their
Chairman and one representative.
(c) Organisations of more than 100 members by their Chair-
man and two representatives.
(d) Organisations and Unions founded on the nature of their
members' former military service by five persons appointed
by the Chief of the Far Eastern Section of the General
Russian Military Union.
Note:- In cases where the Organisations and Unions of
scientific nature have less than 25 members, those organisa-
tions delegate on the Council two representatives.
8. The Heads of the Russian Orthodox Church and other
Christian and non-Christian religious congregations are members
of the Council and each have the right to appoint one repre-
sentative to sit on the Council.
9. The admission to the Council of representatives of newly-
established organisations and unions, and the eviction from
the Council of organisations and unions shall be determined by
the Council. For these purposes the quorum of the Council
shall be three-fifths of the total number of its members. In
the case of admission the question shall be decided by a
simple majority vote and in the case of eviction by a majority
of not less then three-fourths of the members present.
10. The Council is headed by a Presidium consisting of a
Chairman, two Vice-Chairmen, a Honorary Secretary and a
Honorary Treasurer, who shall be elected by the Council from
amongst its members for the period of ONE YEAR.
11. The Council may appoint from amongst its members Sub-
Committees for the purpose of reporting to the Council. Sub-
Committees shall be at liberty to co-opt non-members of the
Council and non-members of organisations having their repre-
sentatives on the Council, who are essential to ensure the
success of the work of these Sub-Committees.
IV. Funds of the Council.
12. The funds of the Council are formed of members' fees to
be paid by the bodies having their Representatives on the
Council, and of various sums, voluntary contributions and
any other income.
— 2 —
page_data.zh:
(b) 成员在25至100人之间的组织，由其主席和一名代表代表。
(c) 成员超过100人的组织，由其主席和两名代表代表。
(d) 基于成员先前兵役性质成立的组织和联盟，由全俄军人联盟远东分部主任任命的五人代表。
注：如果科学性质的组织和联盟成员少于25人，这些组织将委派两名代表参加理事会。
8. 俄罗斯东正教会及其他基督教和非基督教宗教团体的负责人是理事会成员，且每人有权任命一名代表列席理事会。
9. 新成立的组织和联盟的代表加入理事会，以及组织和联盟被逐出理事会，均由理事会决定。为此目的，理事会的法定人数为其成员总数的五分之三。在接纳情况下，问题由简单多数票决定；在驱逐情况下，由不少于出席成员四分之三的多数票决定。
10. 理事会由一个主席团领导，主席团由一名主席、两名副主席、一名名誉秘书和一名名誉司库组成，他们应由理事会从其成员中选举产生，任期一年。
11. 理事会可从其成员中任命小组委员会，以便向理事会报告。小组委员会有权增选非理事会成员以及在理事会有代表的组织的非成员，这些人对于确保这些小组委员会工作的成功至关重要。
四、理事会的资金。
12. 理事会的资金由在理事会拥有代表的团体缴纳的会费，以及各种款项、自愿捐款和任何其他收入组成。
— 2 —

page_data.en:
V. Competence of the Council.
13. The Competence of the Council extends over questions and affairs connected with the aims pursued by the Council in general and in particular as follows:-
1. Election of the Presidium of the Council.
2. Amendment and completion of the present Regulations, which can only be passed at a meeting of the Council with a quorum of three-fifths of the total number of its members and by a majority of not less than three-quarters of all present at the meeting.
3. Composition of the Council and questions of its internal organisation.
4. Determination and Approval of the Council's scheme of operation; consideration and approval of reports, estimates, financial accounts, etc.
5. Registration of all Russians, non-citizens of the U.R.S.S; their assistance in obtaining official passports and visas; issuing to them of certificates and personal papers concerning their family, property position, education and service; certifying of Russian translations and signatures. Statistics of births and deaths.
6. Registration of persons capable of serving in the Municipal and Public Utility Institutions; registration of unemployed and their assistance in obtaining work.
7. Questions relating to participation of the Russian Community of Shanghai in the social functions of the International Community at Shanghai.
8. Organisation of new societies, associations and unions, and their assistance in obtaining registration from the proper authorities.
9. Questions of mutual relations between various Russian Public Bodies and co-ordination and extension of their activities in sponsoring cultural and educational requirements of the Community, and economic and other forms of mutual support.
10. Questions connected with the support of the commercial, industrial and professional activities of various Russian organisations, groups and individuals of Russian
— 3 —
page_data.zh:
五、理事会之职权。
13. 理事会之职权涵盖与理事会总体及具体目标相关之问题与事务，具体如下：-
1. 选举理事会主席团。
2. 修订及补充本章程，此类修订仅可在理事会会议上通过，会议法定人数须为理事总人数的五分之三，且须经出席会议者不少于四分之三的多数票通过。
3. 理事会之组成及其内部组织问题。
4. 确定并批准理事会之运作方案；审议并批准报告、预算、财务账目等。
5. 登记所有非苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟公民之俄国人；协助其获取官方护照及签证；向其签发有关其家庭、财产状况、教育及服务经历之证书及个人文件；认证俄语译文及签名。出生与死亡统计。
6. 登记有能力在市政及公用事业机构服务之人员；登记失业人员并协助其就业。
7. 关于上海俄侨社群参与上海国际社群社会职能之问题。
8. 组织新社团、协会及工会，并协助其从主管当局获得注册。
9. 各俄国公共团体之间相互关系之问题，以及在赞助社群文化教育需求、经济及其他形式互助方面协调并扩展其活动之问题。
10. 与支持在上海之各类俄国组织、团体及具有俄罗斯
— 3 —

page_data.en:
nationality at Shanghai and furnishing them with all
kinds of informations regarding municipal bye-laws,
taxation, building permits, opening of factories, shops,
and other commercial and industrial enterprises;
assistance in obtaining various permits under these
bye-laws.

11. Determination of questions regarding lease, purchase,
mortgage and disposal of movable and real property of
the Council, as well as of questions connected with
contracts and obligations required for the realisation
of the aims pursued by the Council.

VI. Management of Affairs.

14. The administration of the Council's affairs is in the hands
of an assembly of persons referred to in Section III of these
Regulations. All questions within the competence of the
Council are determined by a simple majority of votes of
those present at the Meetings except in cases expressly
mentioned in these Regulations.

15. Resolutions and Reports of Council's meetings, as well as
its financial accounts are published for general information
either in special Council's bulletins or in Russian periodicals
in Shanghai.

16. The quorum of the Council's meetings is formed by one
half of the general number of members of the Council.
The Meetings are conducted under the chairmanship of
the Chairman of the Council or in his absence under the
chairmanship of one of the Vice-Chairmen.

17. The Council holds annual, ordinary and extraordinary
Meetings. Annual Meeting are called at the end of each year.
Ordinary Meetings are called at the dates fixed beforehand
by the Council, but not less than once a month, the Presidium
approving the agenda. Extraordinary Meetings, in case of
emergency, are called either by the Chairman of the Council
at his discretion or by a written notice addressed to him by one
of the Vice-Chairmen or by a similar notice of one-fifth of
the total number of the members of the Council.

18 The Presidium of the Council forms the Executive Body
of the Council. It executes all decisions of the Council
according to their accurate meaning.

— 4 —
page_data.zh:
国籍人士之商业、工业及专业活动相关之问题，并向其提供有关市政附例、税收、建筑许可、开设工厂、商店及其他工商业企业之各类信息；协助其根据上述附例获取各类许可。

11. 确定有关理事会动产及不动产之租赁、购买、抵押及处置问题，以及为实现理事会所追求目标所需之合同及义务相关问题。

六、事务管理。

14. 理事会事务之行政工作由本章程第三节所述之人员组成的会议负责。除本章程明确提及之情况外，理事会职权范围内之所有问题均由出席会议者之简单多数票决定。

15. 理事会会议之决议及报告，以及其财务账目，均通过理事会特别公报或上海之俄文期刊发布，以供公众知晓。

16. 理事会会议之法定人数由理事会成员总数之一半构成。会议由理事会主席主持，若主席缺席，则由副主席之一主持。

17. 理事会举行年度会议、例行会议及特别会议。年度会议于每年年底召开。例行会议按理事会预先确定之日期召开，但每月不得少于一次，议程由主席团批准。特别会议在紧急情况下，可由理事会主席酌情召集，或由一名副主席向其发出书面通知召集，或由占理事会成员总数五分之一的成员发出类似通知召集。

18. 理事会主席团构成理事会之执行机构。它按照决议的确切含义执行理事会之所有决定。

— 4 —

page_data.en:
19. All papers, documents, decisions, declarations issued in
the name of the Council, as well as agreements, powers of
attorney and other documents approved by the Council are
valid only if bearing the signature of the Chairman of the
Council or in his absence, that of one of the Vice-Chairmen.
20. All Funds of the Council are to be kept in a Bank on
a current account in the name of the Council, except a sum
not exceeding Mex. Dollars One Hundred for current expenses
which is kept by the Treasurer of the Council. Cheques are
signed by the Chairman and Honorary Treasurer of the
Council.
21. The Council has its own seal and a permanent office.
VII. Audit Committee.
22. For auditing of funds and financial accounts of the Council
an Auditing Committee is to be established. The Council
elects from amongst the members of Organisations and
Associations having their representatives on the Council,
but not from amongst those on the Council, three members
and two candidates to serve on this Committee for a period of
ONE YEAR. The Audit Committee is presided over by a
Chairman elected by the Committee from amongst its members.
Funds and accounts are audited monthly and reports and
findings of the Committee are submitted to the Council.

— 5 —
page_data.zh:
19. 所有以理事会名义签发的文件、文书、决定、声明，以及经理事会批准的协议、授权委托书和其他文件，仅在带有理事会主席签名，或在主席缺席时带有副主席之一签名的情况下方为有效。
20. 理事会之所有资金应存入银行，以理事会名义开立活期账户，但用于日常开支且不超过墨洋一百元之款项由理事会司库保管。支票由理事会主席及名誉司库签署。
21. 理事会拥有自己的印章及固定办公处所。
七、审计委员会。
22. 为审计理事会之资金及财务账目，应设立审计委员会。理事会从在理事会中有代表的各组织及协会的成员中（但不包括理事会成员本身）选举三名成员及两名候补成员担任该委员会委员，任期一年。审计委员会由委员会从其成员中选举产生之主席主持。资金及账目每月审计一次，委员会之报告及调查结果提交理事会。

— 5 —

page_data.en:
議决准用文件非經總會主席簽字或於主席缺席時經副主席一人簽字
者不生效力

第六節 事務管理
第十四條 總會事務由本章第三節所規定之人員處理之
除本章另有規定外總會權限內之事項由到會人數之半數表決之
第十五條 總會會議之決議案報告書及其賬目應登載於總會之告內或刊登於上
海俄文週報
第十六條 總會會議以半數出席者為法定人數會議由總會主席為主席缺席時由
副主席為主席
第十七條 總會會議分年會常會及非常會議年會於每年年終召集之常會於總會
預定之期日召集之每月至少一次其議程由主席預定之情形急迫時主
席得以己意或由副主席之書面通知或由會員五分之一書面要求由主
席召集之
第十八條 總會主席關係總會之行政機關依總會決議之事項施行之
第十九條 凡代表總會名義定之文書文件決議案宣言契約委任狀及其他經總會

死亡之統計
(六) 市政及公用機關人才之登記失業人之登記及助覓工作
(七) 關於上海俄僑參加公共團體之事件
(八) 組織新社團公會及使其得該管機關之註冊
(九) 關於俄僑公共團體相互間關係之問題及關於該團體等對於俄
僑需要之敎育及文化事業之連絡及發展並經濟上或其他互助
之事項
(十) 關於扶持俄僑經營之商業工業及職業等事業及扶助其他團體
及私人之事項並供給關於市府章程納稅規則建築執照經營工
廠商店及其他商業或工業等事項之必要知識並使其依據章程

四

之

第十三條 總會權限普通及於有關其所追求之宗旨之事項及下列特定之各項
(一) 選舉總會主席團
(二) 修正及補充本章程但須由總會會員五分之三出席並至少到會
會員四分之三之票數始能通過
(三) 總會之組織及其內部組織之事件

(五) 非蘇俄國籍俄僑之登記助領護照及文件發給關於家屬財產地
位教育及服務資格之證書鑑定俄文譯本及其簽字字樣出生及

（丁）以退伍軍人爲會員之團體及公會由俄國軍人公會遠東部主席
所委五人代表之
（註）不滿二十五人之學術團體及公會由其代表二人爲代表
第八條 俄國正教教會之主教及其他基督教或非基督教教會之主教均爲總會
委員並各得委派代表一人爲出席總會代表
第九條 新團體及新公會代表之入會及會員之格除由總會委員會處斷之決議
允准入會及格除退會之事項須有全體會員五分之三之出席人數方得

第十條 總會之最高機關爲主席團由主席一人副主席二人名譽秘書及名譽會

二

表

第三節 組織
第七條 總會由現已成立及將來成立以民族學術職業學業工業社交及營業爲

(甲) 不滿二十五人之團體除本章程另後規定外由其主席或其代表
(委員)為代表
(乙) 二十五人以上不滿百人之團體由其主席及其他代表人為代表

上海俄僑公共聯合會章程

第一節 本會之宗旨與目的
第一條 俄僑公共團體聯合總會為謀連絡一致上海各俄僑公共團體之事業又
為對於上海非蘇俄國民俄僑之法津上及營業上之利益有所代表之團
體並受保障而設立
第二條 俄僑公共團體聯合總會更以輔助上海合法統治機關使於需要時協力
維持上海之和平秩序及良好管理為宗旨

第二節 實現宗旨之方法
第三條 總會以遵從中華民國法律以上海公共租界與法租界之現行行政及市
政規程為實行前節之宗旨
第四條 總會於其權限內得斟酌及處斷關於上海俄僑居留地之公共及營業關

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, MARCH 24, 1933

UNITED RUSSIAN
ORGANISATION

Resignation of Mr. Katanov;
Election on April 20

A meeting of the Council of the
United Russian Public Organisa-
tions in Shanghai was held on the
premises of this body at 39 Avenue
Foch VII on Tuesday. It was
attended by 26 representatives of
various Russian public bodies.

After a detailed report of the ac-
tivities of the Council for the past
few months and of the completion of
negotiations connected with the offi-
cial registration of this body by
the Bureau of Social Affairs of
Greater Shanghai, Mr. A. N.
Katanov tendered his resignation as
Chairman with great regret. He
stated that the formation of the
Council had been a labour of
love and necessitated a heavy duty
and cost him a great deal of time
and effort, and that the continued
growth of the organisation would
not lessen the duties and tasks of
the Chairman. He felt that his
office in the service of the Munici-
pal Council should not suffer, but he
hoped his successors that his interest
in them would continue to be as
keen as ever.

After an expression of deep ap-
preciation to Mr. Katanov for his
splendid work in the interest of the
Russian Community, it was resolved
to accept his resignation with the
effect from March 16.

Mr. A. M. Shmakoff, M.D., vice-
chairman, was nominated to act in
his place pending the election to be
held on April 20.

（批：O/c S.S.）
（批：SBR. 24/3）

Commr. of Police.

联合俄国组织

卡塔诺夫先生辞职；
4月20日选举

周二，上海联合俄国公共组织理事会会议在该机构位于福煦路（Avenue Foch VII）39号的驻地举行。出席会议的有来自各俄国公共团体的26名代表。

在详细报告了过去几个月理事会的活动情况，以及与大上海市政府社会局就该机构正式注册事宜进行的谈判已完成之后，A. N. Katanov 先生怀着极大的遗憾辞去了主席职务。他表示，组建理事会是一项出于热忱的工作，需要承担繁重的责任，耗费了他大量的时间和精力，而且组织的持续增长并不会减轻主席的职责和任务。他认为自己在工部局的服务工作不应受到影响，但他希望继任者们知道，他对他们的兴趣将一如既往地浓厚。

在对 Katanov 先生为俄侨社群利益所做的出色工作表示深切感谢后，会议决定接受其辞职，自3月16日起生效。

副主席 A. M. Shmakoff 博士被提名在其职位空缺期间代理职务，直至4月20日举行选举。

Subject (in full) Council for United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai
( " SORO " ).
Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached cutting from the North-
China Daily News of November 10, 1932, concerning the " Council for
United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai" ( SORO ), I have
to state that a report was submitted on September 6, 1932
( file D. 2882 ) containing a brief outline of the circumstances
under which this body was established on January 17, 1932, as
well as particulars regarding its standing in the local Russian
community.

A translation of the three first paragraphs of the sta-
tute governing the activity of this organization reads as follows:

1. The Council for United Russian Public Organizations at
Shanghai is established for the unification and co-ordina-
tion of activities of all Russian public organizations in
Shanghai and is an organ of representation and defence of
legal rights and interests of Russian nationals in Shanghai
other than citizens of the U.S.S.R.

2. The Council will also render assistance to the lawful
authorities in the task of maintaining law, peace and or-
der in the territory of Shanghai, when requested to do so
by these authorities.

3. In the pursuance of the aims mentioned above the Council
is guided by the laws of the present Republic of China, as
well as by the administrative and municipal regulations in
force in the territories of the International Settlement
and the French Concession in Shanghai.

In accordance with paragraph 3 of the statute a petition
was submitted to the Chinese authorities on June 30, 1932, request-
ing their permission for the establishment and registration of
the Council for the United Russian Public Organizations in Shang-
hai. This petition was signed by 34 members of the council and
was forwarded through the medium of Dr. John C.H. Wu ( adviser to
the Shanghai Municipal Council and legal adviser of SORO ) to the
Executive Committee of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang
Headquarters.

On August 4, 1932 a reply was received from the local [obscured]

主题（全称）上海联合俄国公共组织理事会（“SORO”）。
制作人 D.S. Prokofiev 转发人 [签名]

关于附件中1932年11月10日《字林西报》有关“上海联合俄国公共组织理事会”（SORO）的剪报，本人谨陈述如下：曾于1932年9月6日提交一份报告（档案 D. 2882），简要概述了该机构于1932年1月17日成立的背景，以及其在当地俄侨社群中的地位详情。

该组织活动章程前三段的译文如下：

1. 上海联合俄国公共组织理事会旨在统一和协调上海所有俄国公共组织的活动，是代表和维护在上海的非苏联公民俄国国民合法权利和利益的机构。

2. 理事会亦将在当局要求时，协助合法当局维持上海地区的法律、和平与秩序。

3. 为实现上述目标，理事会遵循中华民国现行法律，以及上海公共租界和法租界地区现行的行政及市政规章。

根据章程第3条，于1932年6月30日向中国当局提交请愿书，请求批准成立并注册上海联合俄国公共组织理事会。该请愿书由34名理事会成员签署，并通过吴经熊博士（工部局顾问兼 SORO 法律顾问）转呈上海特别区国民党党部执行委员会。

Taking into consideration that some of the regulations governing
the activity of Chinese public organizations are not applicable within the
territories of the foreign settlements and may hinder the activity of the
Council for United Russian Organizations, the legal adviser of the council
applied to the same authorities for a special certificate of registration.
In a reply dated October 8, 1932, the Executive Committee of the Shanghai Spe-
cial District Kuomintang Headquarters informed the petitioners that pending
the promulgation by the Central Committee of the Kuomintang of regulations
governing the establishment of Foreign Residents Associations, no special
certificate of registration (diploma) can be issued.
On October 18 and 19 the following official notification which was
drawn up by Dr. Yu and approved " by the authorities concerned", was publish-
ed in the " Chen Pao", organ of the Kuomintang, the " Min Pao" and the " Shun
Pao": -
" The United Russian Organization in Shanghai hereby notifies the
public of the following: -
Since some time recently the abovementioned organization has been
preparing for its formal inauguration. At present, in compliance
with and by virtue of orders of the Shanghai Special District Kuo-
mintang Headquarters, dated August 4 and October 8, 1932 respective-
ly, granting permission for the establishment (inauguration), a ge-
neral meeting will be held at 4 p.m. on Sunday November 6, at No 39
Avenue Edward VII for the purpose of the formal inauguration of this
organization. The public is hereby specially notified".
Considering that the registration with the Chinese authorities has in-
troduced the Council into a new phase of its activity, and with a view to
facilitating the unification of all Russian organizations in Shanghai into
this body, the presidium of the Council decided to resign from office and

民党总部称，新团体的注册许可已获批准。
鉴于管辖中国公共组织活动的某些规定并不适用于外国租界地区，且可能阻碍俄罗斯组织联合会的活动，该联合会的法律顾问向同一当局申请了特别注册证书。
在1932年10月8日的回复中，上海特别区国民党执行委员会告知申请人，在国民党中央委员会颁布关于外籍居民协会成立的条例之前，无法签发特别注册证书（文凭）。
10月18日和19日，由于博士起草并经“有关当局”批准的以下官方通告刊登在国民党机关报《晨报》、《民报》和《申报》上：-
“上海俄罗斯组织联合会特此向公众通告如下：-
近段时间以来，上述组织一直在筹备正式成立事宜。目前，遵照并依据上海特别区国民党总部分别于1932年8月4日和10月8日发布的关于批准成立（ inaugurated ）的命令，定于11月6日星期日下午4时在爱多亚路39号举行大会，以正式成立本组织。特此专门通告公众”。
鉴于向中国当局注册使联合会进入了其活动的新阶段，并且为了促进上海所有俄罗斯组织统一加入该团体，联合会主席团决定辞职，并邀请不属于SORO集团的所有组织派代表参加11月6日的会议，以便根据SORO章程选举新的主席团。

It must be mentioned that out of I9 organizations not be-

other organizations having declined the invitation for various
reasons.
In compliance with Chinese law the minutes of this meet-
ing together with the statute of the new organization will be sub-
mitted to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang Headquarters
and to the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai to be recorded in the registers of these institutions.
The significance of the registration of SORO with the
Chinese authorities is explained by Mr. A.M.Kotenev as follows:-
I. The registration of public organizations in China,other
than commercial and charitable, is a prerogative of the
Supreme Power which at present belongs to the Kuomintang
and its organs. Thus,the permission for registration
granted to SORO,as an act of the Supreme Power of the
country,is therefore final and conclusive.

SORO has acquired the full rights of a public body with

A.M.科特涅夫先生对SORO向中国当局注册的意义解释如下：-
1. 在中国，除商业和慈善组织外，公共组织的注册是最高权力的特权，目前这一权力属于国民党及其机构。因此，作为国家最高权力行为授予SORO的注册许可是最终且具有决定性的。

Russian community represented by the Russian Emigrants Committee,

随着SORO向中国当局注册，该团体的一般活动，特别是A.K.科特涅夫先生的活动，引起了当地俄罗斯社群中以俄罗斯移民委员会为代表的反对派群体的诸多评论和负面批评，简要总结如下：-

1. “正式成立”的SORO是同一群无原则政客试图通过建立一个准公共性质的机构来误导当地俄罗斯社群的又一次尝试。自1925年该团体挑战前沙俄驻上海领事V.F.格罗斯先生代表俄罗斯社群的权威以来，三次类似的尝试均彻底失败：“俄罗斯社群权益保护委员会”、“俄罗斯民族社群”和“SORO”——所有这些举措开始时都

俄罗斯统一组织
成立及职员选举

上周日，俄罗斯统一公共组织在该机构位于爱德华七世路39号的办公场所举行了正式成立仪式。

此次成立会议是根据上海特别区国民党总部1932年8月4日和10月4日的命令召开的，该命令批准俄罗斯统一组织设立办事处。出席会议的有包括俄罗斯犹太社区代表在内的各俄罗斯公共团体的87名正式授权代表。

以下人员一致当选为理事会成员：A. M. 伊万诺夫（Ivanov）先生，主席；V. G. 福明（Fomin）先生和S. N. 斯米尔诺夫（Smirnov）博士，副主席；P. V. 库兹涅佐夫（Kuznetsov）先生，秘书；N. E. 别利亚耶夫（Belyaev）先生，司库；以及A. I. 彼得罗夫（Petrov）、S. P. 索科洛夫（Sokolov）、I. M. 沃尔科夫（Volkov）、D. A. 莫罗佐夫（Morozov）、K. L. 诺维科夫（Novikov）、F. G. 奥尔洛夫（Orlov）、G. H. 帕夫洛夫（Pavlov）和L. I. 夸西莫多（Quasimodo）等先生，理事。

会议通过了一套指导理事会工作的规章及附则。这些规章将送交上海工部局和中国当局审批备案。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Translation of an anonymous letter circulated among the Russian Community criticizing Mr. A.M. Kotenev, President of the Council of United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai (SORO).
D. 4 / 11 / 32

It is a matter of indifference to us which organization will represent the Russian community in Shanghai: SORO, the Russian Emigrants Committee or some new organization, provided that the leaders of such organization are Russian citizens who are sincerely opposed to Bolshevism and who have nothing in common with open and secret Soviet agents.

Therefore, we deem it our duty to warn the Russian community in Shanghai against a "leader" of A.M. Kotenev's type.

We accuse him of the following:-

I. During the period of Mr Kotenev "holding the power" he has issued emigrant's certificates of registration to the following Soviet agents:-

a) N.P. Petuhoff, ex-instructor of the Communist Youth group in Harbin obtained an emigrant's passport with the assistance of Mr. Kotenev.

b) S.L. Meilman - Soviet agent who arrived here from America in June 1932 obtained an emigrant's passport thanks to Mr. Kotenev's letter of recommendation. He left for America in August in order to apply for second papers of naturalization there which he could not do as a Soviet citizen. Meilman is the son of well known local Soviet agent comrade J.G. Dobrishman - to whom a reference is made below.

c) Clara Ismailoff- notorious Soviet agent, ex-employee of the local office of the Chinese Eastern Railway. She is an agent of the G.P.U. and, acting on instructions of this body, posed as a "wife" of the following Soviet "notables":-
O.I. Ismailoff, member of the Board of the Chinese Eastern Railway representing the U.S.S.R.
I.V. Slepak, employee of the Chinese Eastern Railway and a well known Soviet agent.
P.I. Garbuzoff, former manager of the Chinese Eastern Railway, Shanghai branch. He was denounced by C. Ismailoff for having misappropriated the sum of Tls. 12,000 and consequently was recalled to the U.S.S.R. C. Ismailoff obtained with Mr. Kotenev's assistance, an emigrant's passport in the name of Mrs Herzenberg under which name she married a Danish subject.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
一封在俄罗斯社区中流传的匿名信译文，批评上海俄罗斯公共组织联合会理事会（SORO）主席A.M. 科捷涅夫先生。
D. 1932年11月4日

由哪个组织来代表上海的俄罗斯社区对我们来说无关紧要：无论是SORO、俄罗斯移民委员会还是某个新组织，只要该组织的领导人是真诚反对布尔什维克主义且与公开或秘密的苏联代理人毫无瓜葛的俄罗斯公民即可。

因此，我们认为有责任警告上海俄罗斯社区提防像A.M. 科捷涅夫这类“领导人”。

我们指控他如下：

I. 在科捷涅夫先生“掌权”期间，他向下列苏联代理人签发了移民登记证：

a) N.P. 佩图霍夫（Petuhoff），前哈尔滨共产主义青年团指导员，在科捷涅夫先生的协助下获得了移民护照。

b) S.L. 梅尔曼（Meilman），苏联代理人，于1932年6月从美国抵达此处，凭借科捷涅夫先生的推荐信获得了移民护照。他于8月前往美国申请第二份入籍文件，因为作为苏联公民他无法这样做。梅尔曼是当地知名苏联代理人J.G. 多布里什曼（Dobrishman）同志的儿子——下文将提及此人。

c) 克拉拉·伊斯梅洛夫（Clara Ismailoff），臭名昭著的苏联代理人，前中东铁路本地办事处雇员。她是国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）的代理人，并根据该机构的指示，冒充以下苏联“名人”的“妻子”：
O.I. 伊斯梅洛夫（Ismailoff），代表苏联的中东铁路董事会成员。
I.V. 斯列帕克（Slepak），中东铁路雇员及知名苏联代理人。
P.I. 加尔布佐夫（Garbuzoff），前中东铁路上海分公司经理。他被C. 伊斯梅洛夫指控侵吞了12,000两白银，因此被召回苏联。C. 伊斯梅洛夫在科捷涅夫先生的协助下，以赫尔岑贝格（Herzenberg）夫人的名义获得了一本移民护照，并以该名字嫁给了一名丹麦籍人士。

page_data.en:
-2-
The issuing of emigrant's passports to Soviet citizens is, of course,
no crime, and we welcome it. But it is a treachery to issue such passports
to known Soviet agents.
2. From the time of the establishment of SORO Mr Kotenev carries out in-
structions of and is financed by a known local Soviet agent-comrade
J.G.Dobrishman. Dobrishman is employed with a foreign firm and his
work consists in buying Soviet raw products for this firm. In connec-
tion with his work comrade Dobrishman comes into daily contact with A.J.
Levin, manager of the Centrosojus, A.P.Kovaleff manager of the Fish Dept.
of the Centrosojus, and with some other less important Soviet agents.
Dobrishman was formerly employed with the Soviet Trade Mission and other
Soviet firms. Inspite of his evidently non-emigrant activity, Dobrishman
is in possession of an emigrant's passport. However, his brother O.G.Dob-
rishman still holds Soviet passport No 6218(?) issued by the Soviet Con-
sulate in Harbin in January 1927.
3. Instead of endeavouring to bring about the unification of the Russian
community Mr. Kotenev has been engaged in its desorganization, trying to
disintegrate the Union of Cossacks by forming the " United Cossacks
Association".
4. Being the head of a part of Russian organizations Mr. Kotenev wrote a
vile letter to one of the local foreign consuls denouncing a certain lo-
cal Russian organization which does not belong to his group.
5. During the long period of his residence in Shanghai Kotenev did not
take part in the public life of the Russian community. He appeared on
the scene of the public activity only following Mr.V.F.Grosse's death
when the Russian community was on the threshold of unification, which, of
course, the Bolsheviks did not like.
6. Kotenev is endeavouring to enslave the Russian community in the fol-
lowing manner:-
a). To place at the head of SORO a Commissary of the Chinese nationa-
lity and to act as his assistant. Kotenev's plans are supported
by some other "organizations" artificially formed by himself.
b). Following his re-election and the appointment of a Commissary,
Kotenev intends to impose a special tax on local Russian resi-
dents out of which the Commissary's salary will be paid.
c). The registration will be made compulsory and only the regis-
page_data.zh:
-2-
向苏联公民签发移民护照当然不是犯罪，我们对此表示欢迎。但是，向已知的苏联代理人签发此类护照则是背叛行为。

2. 自上海俄国侨民组织（SORO）成立以来，科捷涅夫先生一直执行一名已知的本地苏联代理人——多布里什曼同志（J.G. Dobrishman）的指示，并由其提供资金。多布里什曼受雇于一家外国公司，其工作是为该公司购买苏联原材料。由于工作关系，多布里什曼同志与中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）经理 A.J. Levin、中央消费合作总社鱼类部经理 A.P. Kovaleff 以及其他一些次要的苏联代理人保持日常接触。多布里什曼此前曾受雇于苏联贸易代表团及其他苏联机构。尽管他的活动明显不属于移民性质，多布里什曼却持有移民护照。然而，他的兄弟 O.G. Dobrishman 仍持有苏联领事馆于1927年1月在哈尔滨签发的第6218号(?)苏联护照。

3. 科捷涅夫先生非但没有努力促成俄国侨民社区的统一，反而致力于使其瓦解，试图通过组建“联合哥萨克协会”来分裂哥萨克联盟。

4. 作为部分俄国组织的负责人，科捷涅夫先生向当地一位外国领事写了一封卑鄙的信，诬告一个不属于他团体的当地俄国组织。

5. 在上海长期居住期间，科捷涅夫并未参与俄国侨民社区的公共生活。他仅在 V.F. Grosse 先生去世后，当俄国侨民社区即将实现统一之际才出现在公共活动舞台上，而这当然是布尔什维克所不喜欢的。

6. 科捷涅夫正试图通过以下方式奴役俄国侨民社区：
a). 任命一名中国籍委员领导 SORO，并由其担任助理。科捷涅夫的计划得到了一些由他自己人为组建的其他“组织”的支持。
b). 在重新当选并任命委员后，科捷涅夫打算向当地俄国居民征收特别税，用以支付委员的薪水。
c). 登记将成为强制性措施，且只有通过 SORO 进行的登

page_data.en:
-3-
tion through the medium of SORO will be recognized by the Chinese
vernment.

In conclusion of our letter we declare that utmost care should
be exercised in electing the persons who will represent the Russian Com-
munity. It must be always borne in mind that an enemy within is far more
dangerous than an an enemy without.

What for deserve suspicious individuals like Kotenev, if we have the
following persons who are honest and are sincerely opposed to Bolshevism:-
General Dietericks, Captain Fomin, General Walter, Mr. Metzler, Mr.
Yavdynsky, Mr. Belchenko, General Zimin, Mr. Dmitriev, Mr. Kuznetzov
( Doctor) , Admiral Besuar , Mr Eltekoff, General Jukoff and others.

A group of Russian Emigrants.

记才会被中国政府承认。

在信末，我们要声明，在选举代表俄国侨民社区的人员时应极其谨慎。必须始终牢记，内部的敌人比外部的敌人危险得多。

既然我们有以下诚实且真诚反对布尔什维克的人士，像科捷涅夫这样可疑的人还有什么资格受到信任呢：
迪特里希斯将军（General Dietericks）、福明上尉（Captain Fomin）、沃尔特将军（General Walter）、梅茨勒先生（Mr. Metzler）、亚夫丁斯基先生（Mr. Yavdynsky）、别尔琴科先生（Mr. Belchenko）、齐明将军（General Zimin）、德米特里耶夫先生（Mr. Dmitriev）、库兹涅佐夫先生（医生）（Mr. Kuznetzov ( Doctor) ）、贝苏阿尔海军上将（Admiral Besuar）、埃尔泰科夫先生（Mr Eltekoff）、茹科夫将军（General Jukoff）等。

一群俄国流亡者。

page_data.en:
Нем безразлично, кто будет возглавлять Русск
колонию Шанхая — будет ли это ОРО, будет ли это Дмитріевскій Ком
тет или какая либо новая организація; лишь бы в плеядѣ ея были Ру
скіе люди искренніе противники большевизма, никогда не имѣющіе связи
съ ними, ни о тайными обязательствами.
Поэтому, мы считаем своим долгом предупредить
Русскую эмиграцію Шанхая от такого «возглавителя», как имъ является
Г-н А. М. КОТЕХИНЪ.

1/ За то время, пока Г-н Котехинъ отнялъ у эмиграціи имъ были выданы
эмигрантскіе удостовѣренія слѣдующимъ совѣтскимъ:
а/ Н. П. Пѣтуховъ — бывшій инструкторъ комсомола въ Харьковѣ, получилъ
эмигрантскій паспортъ при помощи Г-на Котехина
б/ О. Л. Мейлахъ — о времени, пріѣхавшій сюда изъ Америки въ Іюлѣ с. г.
по рекомендаціи Котехина получилъ эмигрантскій
паспортъ и въ Августѣ выѣхалъ обратно въ Америку.
Для полученія въ этихъ бумагахъ на право эмиграціоннаго
статуса доказывалось, что ему, какъ совѣтскому служащему
въ томъ числѣ онъ подразумѣвалъ, Мейлахъ является п
ОБЕР-РАБОТНИКОМЪ ИЗОБРЕТАТЕЛЬСТВА т. н. ДО
ДОБРШМАНА, съ которымъ рѣчь будетъ ниже.
в/ Клара Измайлова — извѣстная совѣтская, бывшая служащая мѣс
тной конторы КВЖД. Измайлова арестована ГПУ и п
казала о слѣдствіи о своемъ участіи въ провалахъ
шихъ сотрудниковъ:
О. Исмайловъ — членъ правленія КВЖД и ОСОР.
И. В. Оленинъ — служащій КВЖД и извѣстный совѣтскій агентъ
П. И. Терентьевъ — бывш. управляющій кассой КВЖД
Шенхань. Послѣдній за уличеніе въ работѣ ГПУ
10 лѣтъ былъ осужденъ въ ОСОР. При помощи Коте
хина, Клара Измайлова получила эмигрантскій пас
портъ за имя Г-жи Герценбергъ, что дало ей возм
ность выйти замужъ за Котехина и уѣхать.

Конечно, выдача эмигрантскихъ паспортовъ совѣтскимъ агентамъ не есть по
ступленіе и замазывается, но выдача таковыхъ завдомымъ
совѣтскимъ агентамъ, есть предательство!!!

2/ Отдѣля организаціи ОРО г-нъ Котехинъ инструктируется и ознаком
ляется въ его дятельности по выполненію мѣстныхъ совѣтскихъ заданій.
Добришманъ М. Добришманъ работаетъ въ одной иностранной фирмѣ и яв
ляется офиціальнымъ закупщикомъ соѣваго сырья для
этой фирмы. По своей дѣятельности г-нъ Добришманъ состоитъ въ сно
шеніяхъ съ А. И. Лепихинымъ, директоромъ «Центросоюза», А. П. Коно
плевомъ, завѣдующимъ экспортнымъ отдѣломъ «Центросоюза» и съ другими со
втскими купцами и представителями. Рядомъ съ Добришманомъ служащій Тор
предства и пр. словомъ, Добришманъ, несмотря на его легальную тор
говую дѣятельность, имѣетъ эмигрантскій паспортъ, который онъ полу
чилъ братъ О. Р. Добришмана и онъ имѣетъ сововый № 218, вы
данный Харбинскимъ Совѣтомъ въ 1927 г.
3/ Видя то, что онъ занимается содѣйствіемъ, г-нъ Котехинъ зани
мается развращеніемъ китайцевъ черезъ Китайскій Союзъ, путемъ орга
низаціи Опотец-Казачьей Станицы.

谁将领导上海俄国侨民社区——是俄国侨民组织（ORO），还是德米特里耶夫斯基委员会，或是其他任何新组织，这并非无关紧要；重要的是，在其领导层中要有真诚反对布尔什维克的俄国人，他们从未与布尔什维克有过联系，也没有任何秘密义务。
因此，我们认为有责任警告上海俄国流亡者，提防像 A.M. 科捷欣先生这样的“领导人”。

1/ 在科捷欣先生掌控流亡者事务期间，以下苏联人员在他的帮助下获得了移民证件：
a/ N.P. Petukhov —— 前哈尔科夫共青团指导员，在科捷欣先生的帮助下获得了移民护照。
b/ O.L. Meilakh —— 今年七月从美国抵达此处，经科捷欣推荐获得移民护照，并于八月返回美国。为了在这些文件中获得移民身份的权利，声称他作为苏联雇员，其中包括他是所谓的多布里什曼的“高级发明工作者”，下文将提及此人。
c/ Klara Izmailova —— 知名的苏联分子，前中东铁路（KVZhD）当地办事处职员。Izmailova 被国家政治保卫局（GPU）逮捕，并在调查中供认参与了导致以下同事被捕的事件：
O. Ismailov —— 中东铁路及 OSOR 董事会成员。
I.V. Olenin —— 中东铁路职员及已知的苏联代理人。
P.I. Terentyev —— 前中东铁路上海出纳处经理。最后一人因被揭露为 GPU 工作，在 OSOR 被判刑10年。在科捷欣的帮助下，Klara Izmailova 以 Herzenberg 夫人的名义获得了移民护照，这使她得以嫁给科捷欣并离开。

当然，向苏联代理人签发移民护照并非罪行并可被掩盖，但向已知的苏联代理人签发此类护照则是背叛！！！

2/ 作为 ORO 组织的分支，科捷欣先生接受指令并开展活动，以完成当地的苏联任务。M. Dobrishman 在一家外国公司工作，是该公司的官方大豆原料采购员。根据其业务活动，Dobrishman 先生与“中央消费合作总社”主任 A.I. Lepikhin、“中央消费合作总社”出口部经理 A.P. Konoplev 以及其他苏联商人和代表保持联系。与 Dobrishman 一同工作的还有贸易代表处的职员等。总之，尽管 Dobrishman 从事合法的贸易活动，他却持有移民护照，这是他的兄弟 O.R. Dobrishman 获得的，而他本人持有1927年由哈尔滨苏维埃签发的第218号苏联护照。
3/ 鉴于他从事协助活动，科捷欣先生通过组织 Opotets-Kazachya Stanitsa（音译：奥波捷茨-哥萨克村落），通过中国联盟腐蚀中国人。

Translation of an extract from the "Shanghai Zaria" of
November 3, 1932

WHO WILL BE THE PRESIDENT OF SORO?
( A letter to the Editor)

The unification of Russian organizations in Shanghai is one
of the most important questions for the Russian community ,and if
Russian residents in Shanghai desire to possess the rights of citi-
zens in this large International city,they have first to solve
this problem.
We hope that the re-election of the Presidium of SORO which
will take place on November 6,will bring about the solution of this
problem,but in this connection there is a very important point
which calls for a comment: the person of the new President of SORO
who will represent the Russian community.
Mr.Kotenev's candidature is out of question,as a municipal
employee may not be a member of a political organization.
Then, who will be the new President ?
He must be an educated person who knows foreign languages
and has connections in foreign and Chinese circles; he must be an
absolute anti-bolshevik,as he will represent 15.000 anti-bolsheviks.
Perhaps some of the readers of your esteemed paper will
forward some suggestions regarding this matter which is of much in-
terest to public circles in Shanghai.

On behalf of a group of Russian Emigrants,
Captain M.Pavlov.

（手写批注：）

1932年11月3日《上海朝霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）摘录译文

谁将担任 SORO 主席？
（致编辑的一封信）

上海俄国组织的统一是俄国侨民社区最重要的问题之一，如果上海的俄国居民希望在这个大型国际城市拥有公民权利，他们首先必须解决这个问题。
我们希望将于11月6日举行的 SORO 主席团重选能解决这一问题，但在此方面有一个非常重要的点需要评论：即代表俄国侨民社区的 SORO 新主席人选。
科捷涅夫先生的候选资格不成问题，因为市政雇员不得成为政治组织的成员。
那么，谁将是新主席？
他必须是一个受过教育、懂外语并在外国和中国圈子中有关系的人；他必须是绝对的反布尔什维克主义者，因为他将代表15,000名反布尔什维克主义者。
也许贵报的一些读者会就这一令上海公众圈子非常感兴趣的问题提出一些建议。

代表一群俄国流亡者，
M. Pavlov 上尉。

Нем безразлично, кто будет в заглавлять Русск
калонію Шаххая – будет ли это ООРО, будет ли это Эмигрантскій Ком
тет или какая либо новая организація, лишь бы въ плебѣ отпали Рус
скіе люди искренніе противники большевизма, ничемъ не имѣющіе ни
явными, ни съ тайными связями.
Поэтому, мы считаем своим долгом предостеречь
Русскую эмиграцію Шанхая от такого «возглавителя», как д-ръ А. М. КОТЕНЕВЪ.

Мы обвиняем его въ нижеслѣдующем:
2/ За то время, пока г-н Котенев стоялъ у «Дѣла» им были выгнаны
эмигрантскіе улусы всѣхія отдѣляющим от заслугам;
3/ Н. П. Пѣтуховъ – бывшій контролер Комом ла въ Харбинѣ получил
эмигрантскій паспорт при помощи Г-на Котенева
6/ О. Л. Мейлиэн – о времени, проживавшій один из Америки въ Іюлѣ с
по рекомендаціи Котенева и другим эмигрантскій
паспорт и въ Августѣ пожелал вернуться въ Америку
для полученія въ оных бумаг на право американскаго
гражданства, что было для него невозможно, так как он был арестован
въ том мѣстѣ, гдѣ он жил и судим, приговорен къ 15 лѣтам каторги
и заключен въ тюрьму.
ДОБРЫМЪ ИМЕНЕМ, и тѣм самым будет ниже.
7/ Клара Измайлова – настоящая совѣтская, бывшая служащая мѣст
ной конторы КВЖД. Измайлова арестована ГПУ и п
редана совѣтскому правительству, несмотря на протесты
всѣх эмигрантских организацій.
О. Измайлов – член правленія КВЖД и ОСОР.
Н. В. Славин – служащій КВЖД и мѣстный совѣтскій
П. М. Герценберг – бывш. управляющій хоз. частью КВЖД
Шаххая. Послѣдняя была убита на улицѣ въ районѣ II.
100 и она была оставлена въ СССР. При помощи Коте
нева, Клара Измайлова получила эмигрантскій пас
порт за имя Гани Герценберг, что дало ей возм
ожность выйти замуж за Датохаева и уѣхать.

Конечно, выдача эмигрантских паспортов съ политическими не есть п
оступленіе и намъ прибѣгается, но выдача таковых завѣдомым
совѣтским агентам, есть предательство!!!

2/ Организация ООРО въ Китаѣ инструкторируется и финанси
руется за счет дѣятельности завѣдомым масонам съ извѣстным Б. Л.
Доброшинским. Доброшин работает въ качествѣ иностранной фирмы и е
работа офиціальная заключается въ закупкѣ съ нѣкоторых сырья для
этой фирмы. По своей дѣятельности въ Доброшинском округѣ он сопри
касается съ А. И. Асриным, директором «Центросоюза», А. П. Крав
ченко, завѣдующим русским отдѣлом «Центросоюза» и съ другими со
ветскими служащими. Рядом съ Доброшинским служит Тарас
Григорьев и др., которые, несмотря на его явную совѣтскую
политическую дѣятельность, имѣют эмигрантскій паспорт, что его род
ной брат О. Г. Доброшинскій имѣет совѣтскій № 218, вы
данный Харбинским Окружным Отдѣлом ГПУ въ 1927 г.
3/ Вмѣсто того чтобы вести борьбу съ большевизмом, раз Котенев зани
мался разведеніем пьяных разговоров насчет Казацких Союзов, путем отв
леченія Опочко-Казачьей Станицы.

谁将领导上海俄国侨民社区——是 OOPO，还是流亡者委员会，或是其他任何新组织，这并非无关紧要；重要的是，在其领导层中要有真诚反对布尔什维克的俄国人，他们没有任何公开或秘密的联系。
因此，我们认为有责任警告上海俄国流亡者，提防像 A.M. 科捷涅夫博士这样的“领导人”。

我们指控他如下：
2/ 在科捷涅夫先生掌管“事务”期间，他向所有分离主义者签发了移民证件；
3/ N.P. Petukhov —— 前哈尔科夫共青团控制员，在科捷涅夫先生的帮助下获得了移民护照。
6/ O.L. Meilien —— 今年七月从美国居住于此，经科捷欣推荐和其他人推荐获得移民护照，并于八月希望返回美国以获得美国公民权文件，但这对他来说是不可能的，因为他在居住地被捕并受审，被判15年苦役并监禁。
以善良的名义，下文将提及。
7/ Klara Izmailova —— 真正的苏联分子，前中东铁路（KVZhD）当地办事处职员。Izmailova 被国家政治保卫局（GPU）逮捕并移交给苏联政府，尽管所有流亡者组织提出抗议。
O. Izmailov —— 中东铁路及 OSOR 董事会成员。
N.V. Slavin —— 中东铁路职员及本地苏联分子。
P.M. Herzenberg —— 前中东铁路上海后勤部门经理。最后一人在 II. 区街头被杀，她被留在苏联。在科捷涅夫的帮助下，Klara Izmailova 以 Gani Herzenberg 的名义获得了移民护照，这使她得以嫁给 Datokhaev 并离开。

当然，带有政治目的的移民护照签发并非罪行且为我们所采用，但向已知的苏联代理人签发此类护照则是背叛！！！

2/ 中国的 OOPO 组织由已知的共济会员 B.L. Dobroshinsky 指导和资助。Dobroshin 作为一家外国公司工作，其官方工作是为该公司采购某些原材料。根据其在 Dobroshinsky 地区的活动，他与“中央消费合作总社”主任 A.I. Asrin、“中央消费合作总社”俄语部主任 A.P. Kravchenko 以及其他苏联职员接触。与 Dobroshinsky 一同服务的有 Taras Grigoriev 等人，尽管他有明显的苏联政治活动，却持有移民护照，他的亲兄弟 O.G. Dobroshinsky 持有1927年由哈尔滨地区国家政治保卫局签发的第218号苏联护照。
3/ 科捷涅夫没有进行反布尔什维克斗争，而是通过吸引 Opochko-Kazachya Stanitsa（音译：奥波奇科-哥萨克村落）来散布关于哥萨克联盟的醉酒言论。

page_data.en:
4/ Ст-я по планѣ об'единенія частей русскихъ организацій г-нъ
Котеневъ нашелъ полный тонус одному изъ мѣстныхъ иностран-
ныхъ консуловъ въ пользу всѣхъ мѣстныхъ національныхъ организацій,
не входящихъ въ его об'единеніе.

5/ За свое «долговременное пребываніе» въ Шанхаѣ Котеневъ почти не
принималъ участія въ общественно-политической жизни Русской
колоніи и выступилъ на общественную арену только послѣ сме-
рти В. Ф. Гроссе, когда Русская Колонія была на порогѣ об'-
единенія, что, конечно, не нравилось большевикамъ.

6/ Котеневъ пытался закабалить Русскую колонію слѣдующимъ пу-
темъ:
а/ привлечь къ завѣдыванію ООРО комиссара по Русскимъ плем-
китайца по національности, а онъ, Котеневъ, будетъ его по-
мощникомъ. Намѣренія Котенева встрѣчаютъ сочувствіе и под-
держку со стороны другихъ организацій, но употребленіе имъ
такихъ орудій — не Котеневымъ.
б/ Котеневъ намѣренъ при переизбраніи его и назначеніи Д. М.
ссара, объявить Русскую колонію особымъ райономъ подъ вѣ-
деніемъ всего комиссара.
в/ Регистрація будетъ считаться обязательной и призывать
Китайскимъ правительствомъ дѣйствительной, т. е. при ус-
ловіи полученія ея черезъ эту организацію.

Заканчивая наше обращеніе, мы заявляемъ, что
нужно быть очень осторожнымъ въ выборѣ лицъ, кои будутъ пред-
ставительствовать Русскую колонію и всегда помнить, что

4/ 按照统一部分俄国组织的计划，科捷涅夫先生向一位当地外国领事发表了完全支持所有未加入其统一体的当地民族组织的言论。

5/ 在他“长期居住”上海期间，科捷涅夫几乎未参与俄国侨民社区的社会政治生活，仅在 V.F. Grosse 去世后，当俄国侨民社区处于统一门槛时，他才登上公共舞台，这当然令布尔什维克不悦。

6/ 科捷涅夫试图通过以下方式束缚俄国侨民社区：
a/ 吸引一名中国籍委员负责管理 OOPO，而他，科捷涅夫，将担任其助理。科捷涅夫的意图得到了其他组织的同情和支持，但他使用此类手段——并非科捷涅夫本人。
b/ 科捷涅夫打算在重新当选并任命 D.M. 委员时，宣布俄国侨民社区为受该委员管辖的特别区域。
c/ 登记将被视为强制性，并被中国政府承认为有效，即以通过该组织获得登记为条件。

结束我们的呼吁，我们声明，在选择代表俄国侨民社区的人员时必须非常谨慎，并始终牢记，像科捷涅夫先生这样的内部敌人，公民无权占据职位。

我们再次给出科捷涅夫们，
当我们拥有以下绝对真诚的反布尔什维克主义者和诚实人士时：
迪特里希斯将军、福明海军少将、沃尔特将军、梅茨勒先生、扬波尔斯基先生、别利亚耶夫先生、齐明将军、德米特里耶夫先生、库兹涅佐夫先生（医生）、阿斯米罗夫 A.S.、弗莱克尔先生、古里耶夫先生等。

WHO WILL BE THE PRESIDENT OF SORO?
( A letter to the Editor)

The unification of Russian organizations in Shanghai is one
of the most important questions for the Russian community ,and if
Russian residents in Shanghai desire to possess the rights of citi-
zens in this large International city,they have first to solve
this problem.
We hope that the re-election of the Presidium of SORO which
will take place on November 6,will bring about the solution of this
problem,but in this connection there is a very important point
which calls for a comment; the person of the new President of SORO
who will represent the Russian community.
Mr.Kotenev's candidature is out of question,as a municipal
employee may not be a member of a political organization.
Then, who will be the new President ?
He must be an educated person who knows foreign languages
and has connections in foreign and Chinese circles; he must be an
absolute anti-bolshevik,as he will represent 15.000 anti-bolsheviks.
Perhaps some of the readers of your esteemed paper will
forward some suggestions regarding this matter which is of much in-
terest to public circles in Shanghai.

On behalf of a group of Russian Emigrants,
Captain N.Pavlov.

我们希望于11月6日举行的俄侨联合公会主席团改选能带来这一问题的解决方案，但在此方面有一个非常重要的点需要评论；即代表俄裔社群的新任俄侨联合公会主席的人选。
科特涅夫先生（Mr. Kotenev）的候选人资格不成问题[注：此处原文语意似为“不予考虑”或“有问题”，结合下文“市政雇员不得加入政治组织”，应译为“不予考虑”或“被排除”]，因为市政雇员不得成为政治组织的成员。

也许贵报的一些读者会就这一令上海公众界非常感兴趣的事项提出一些建议。

THE NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, OCTOBER 18, 1932
S. & S. B. REGIST.
No. D

UNITED RUSSIAN
ORGANISATIONS.

Chinese Grant Permission To
Register: New Election

A meeting of the Council of the
United Russian Organisations was
held on Sunday. The meeting was
presided over by Mr. A.M. Kotenev,
Chairman. Representatives of 22
public bodies attended.

After a detailed report of the
activities of the Council for the
past eight months the Chairman
informed the meeting that by two
orders of the Executive Committee
of the Shanghai Special District
Kuomintang Headquarters dated
August 4 and October 6, the United
Russian Public Organisations are
granted permission to register.
These orders were issued in response
to a petition signed by 34 members
of the Council as promoters of this
organisation in compliance with the
resolution of the Council of April
26, that the United Russian Or-
ganisations are to be guided in their
activities by the respective law and
ordinances of the present Chinese
Republic, and by the administrative
and municipal rules and regulations
in force in the International Settle-
ment and French Concession. It
was emphasized at that time that
by the adoption of this maxim the
practices of the United Organisa-
tions will come close into line with
the law of the country, and thus
facilitate it.

Mr. A. M. Kotenev stated that
in view of the importance of official
registration and the formal in-
auguration of the Council which
would follow, the Presidium had
unanimously decided to submit its
resignation so as to enable new
elections to be held.

After an expression of apprecia-
tion to the Chairman and members
of the Presidium for their arduous
work in bringing about the official
registration, it was resolved to ac-
cept their resignation with effect
from November 6, when the formal
inauguration of the new body and
election of officers will be held.

It was further resolved to invite
all Russian Public Organisations in
Shanghai to send their represen-
tatives to join the new body and
participate in the election. Deep
appreciation was also voted to Dr.
John C. H. Wu for his invaluable
assistance in bringing about this
registration.

俄裔联合
组织。

中方准予注册：举行新选举

俄裔联合组织理事会于星期日召开会议。会议由主席 A.M. 科特涅夫先生（Mr. A.M. Kotenev）主持。22个公共团体的代表出席了会议。

在详细报告了过去八个月理事会的活动后，主席告知会议，根据上海特别区国民党总部执行委员会于8月4日和10月6日发布的两项命令，俄裔公共联合组织获准注册。这些命令是针对由理事会34名成员作为该组织发起人签署的请愿书而发出的，此举符合理事会4月26日的决议，即俄裔联合组织在其活动中应以当前中华民国的相应法律和条例，以及公共租界和法租界现行的行政和市政规章制度为指导。当时强调，通过采纳这一准则，联合组织的做法将与国家法律趋于一致，从而促进其合法化。

A.M. 科特涅夫先生表示，鉴于正式注册的重要性以及随之而来的理事会正式就职，主席团已一致决定辞职，以便举行新的选举。

在对主席和主席团成员为实现正式注册所付出的辛勤工作表示感谢后，会议决定接受他们的辞呈，自11月6日起生效，届时将举行新机构的正式就职典礼和官员选举。

会议还决定邀请上海所有俄裔公共组织派遣代表加入新机构并参与选举。会议还对吴经熊博士（Dr. John C. H. Wu）在促成此次注册过程中提供的宝贵协助表示深切感谢。

BEHIND THE CURTAIN OF "SORO"
----
What A.M. Ketenev occupied himself with?
-----
A self-explanatory document.
-----

We are publishing below the full text of A.M. Kotenev's
letter to the Juridical Committee of SORO (Council of United
Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai) the origin of which,
as it will be seen from the text, was due to the political
manipulations in which A.M. Ketenev indulged himself recently
in his capacity as President of SORO.
We suggest that our readers think it over carefully.
It does not call for our special comment, as it is clear to
all what aims A. M. Ketenev pursued in this letter.

Editor.

------------------

Council of the United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai.
39 Avenue Edward VII.

March 29, 1932.
Shanghai.

To the Council's Juridical Committee.

Gentlemen,

In connection with the registration of the Council's
statute with the Chinese Authorities which will take place
shortly, I have outlined certain amendments and supplements
to the statute as, according to my information, its present
wording will undoubtedly meet with very serious objections.
Enclosing herewith a draft of the amendments and supplements
above referred to, I have the honour to request you to examine,
as soon as possible, the new wording of the statute and to let
me know your opinion, in order that I may submit a report on
this matter at the next meeting of the Council.
At the same time I beg to request you to let me have
your opinion on the following points which are dealt with in
the revised wording of the statute :-
1. Whether it is practicable and desirable that the
Chinese stamp-duty be paid on certificates and
testimonials of registration, identity, family and
property status, education and professional
qualifications issued by the Council.
2. What stamp-duty should be levied by the Council for
certifying the correctness of translations from the
Russian into a foreign language or vice versa, as
well as for certifying signatures on agreements and
powers of attorney.
Apart from the above, I have received information
regarding certain repressions which the Chinese Authorities
intend to take against Russian emigrants in connection with
certain activities of the latter during the recent events

关于附上的1932年8月22日《上海泰晤士报》剪报，我必须指出，本地中文报刊上出现的关于名为“上海俄裔居民联合会”的新“白”俄组织成立的报道，显然指的是位于爱多亚路39号、由 A.M. 科特涅夫先生（Mr. A.M. Kotenev）担任主席的被称为“上海俄裔公共组织联合会”（SCRO）的组织。
该组织成立于1932年初。回想起来，1931年10月，在“俄裔移民委员会”主席 V.F. 格罗斯先生（Mr V.F. Grosse）去世后不久，“俄裔移民委员会”与“俄罗斯民族共同体”——上海两个主要的俄裔组织——的代表开始谈判，目的是统一上海的所有俄裔组织。在1931年10月26日和11月12日举行的各俄裔组织代表两次会议期间，达成了一项初步协议，即应成立一个上海俄裔社群的新行政和代表机构，并选举了一个委员会来制定该当选机构的章程计划以及选举顺序。
然而，经过委员会的几次会议后，显而易见的是，两个对立组织的代表在某些问题上无法达成一致，因此谈判破裂，随后“俄罗斯民族共同体”决定与所谓的“第三势力”——即不属于上述两个组织的组织和个人——合作继续开展统一工作。结果是主席团的

" Council of the United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai
was elected on January 17, 1932. Steps taken by the new organi-
zation in order to secure recognition by the Chinese Authori-
ties account for the reports published in the Chinese Press.
As the " Russian Emigrants Committee" is functioning
independently of the newly formed body, it is evident that the
unification movement has proved a failure and that, therefore,
the name of the " Council of United Russian Public Organiza-
tions at Shanghai" is rather misleading.
Both sides have much to say in explanation of the fai-
lure to come to an agreement and to put an end to the deplor-
able state of dissension in which Russian public organizations
have been for the past several years. To an outside observer,
however, it seems that the element of personal antagonism and
distrust among a limited number of persons - result of several
years of controversies - has played an unduly prominent part in
the negotiations. On the other hand, lack of interest in public
affairs on the part of the majority of the local Russian commu-
nity may account for the fact that sufficient pressure has not
been brought to bear on the rival parties in order to compel
them to come to an understanding. It is believed also that
there are among the Russian community some Soviet " agents-pro-
vocateurs" whose activity is directed towards the disorganiz-
ing the ranks of the " Whites".
Attached herewith are lists containing the names of
the various Russian organizations supporting either the " Rus-
sian Emigrants Committee" or the " Council of United Russian
Public Organizations at Shanghai", together with a list of the

-2-
“上海俄国公共组织联合会”于1932年1月17日选举产生。该新组织为争取中国当局承认而采取的步骤，解释了中国报刊上刊登的相关报道。鉴于“俄国侨民委员会”独立于新成立的机构运作，显然统一运动已告失败，因此，“上海俄国公共组织联合会”这一名称颇具误导性。

双方就未能达成协议以及结束过去几年来俄国公共组织所处的令人痛心的分裂状态，各有许多说辞。然而，在旁观者看来，少数人之间因多年争论而产生的个人敌意和不信任因素，在谈判中起到了过分突出的作用。另一方面，当地俄国社区大多数人对公共事务缺乏兴趣，这可能解释了为何未能对对立各方施加足够的压力以迫使他们达成谅解。据信，俄国社区中还有一些苏联“挑衅代理人”，其活动旨在瓦解“白俄”阵营。

more important organizations who prefer to remain " neutral".
It must be said, however, that of these numerous organiza-
tions comparatively few are engaged in active work among their
nationals. The majority of them can be described as groups of
persons unified either by their connections in the past or com-
mon interests, and their activity is mostly limited to mutual
aid. There are also some organizations with high sounding names,
which exist only on paper and whose membership is barely suffi-
cient to fill vacancies in their " governing boards".
In the absence of an authoritative organ which could
organize proper elections in the Russian community, an agreement
between the " Russian Emigrants Committee" and the" Council of
United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai" seems to be
the only manner in which local Russian organizations can be
unified, and a body representing the local Russian community
formed and recognized as such by the authorities of the three
Municipalities.

更倾向于保持“中立”的重要组织名单。
然而必须指出，在这些众多组织中， comparatively few（相对较少）在其本国侨民中开展积极工作。大多数组织可描述为因过去的联系或共同利益而结合的人群团体，其活动主要限于互助。还有一些组织名称响亮，但仅存在于纸面上，其成员 barely sufficient（勉强足够）填补其“理事会”的空缺。

由于缺乏一个能在俄国社区组织适当选举的权威机构，“俄国侨民委员会”与“上海俄国公共组织联合会”之间的协议似乎是统一当地俄国组织、并形成代表当地俄国社区的机构且获得三市当局承认的唯一途径。

SOUTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, APRIL 28, 1932

UNITED RUSSIAN
ORGANISATIONS

Activities to be Guided by
Chinese Law

An extraordinary meeting of the
Council of the United Russian
Organisations was held on Tuesday.
The meeting was presided over by
Mr. A. M. Kotenev, Chairman. Re-
presentatives of 32 public bodies
attended.
The agenda included certain
amendments of Council's regulations
and bye-laws. The main interest
was focussed on the question as to
whether the Council is to function
under the old Russian Imperial Law
or under the Chinese law.
Up to the present time, Russian
public organisations at Shanghai
have functioned under the old
Russian Imperial law and ordinances
governing the activities of public
associations and unions.
After a lively discussion it was
unanimously decided that the Coun-
cil is to be guided in its activities by
the respective law and ordinances of
the present Chinese Republic, and by
the administrative and municipal
rules and regulations in force in the
territories of the International
settlement and French Concession.
The application of the old Russian
law should be confined to cases com-
ing under the provision of the "Rules
for Application of Foreign Law in
Chinese Courts," of the 7th year of
the Chinese Republic.
It was stated that by the adoption
of this maxim the practice of this
Council will come close into line with
the law of the country, and thus
facilitate it.
It should be remembered that the
Council of the United Russian Public
Associations is a non-political and
non-factional body established to re-
present legally the Russian Com-
munity and to co-ordinate the
activities of the Russian public
bodies at Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
《南华早报》，1932年4月28日，星期四

全俄组织联合会

活动将受中国法律指导

全俄组织联合会理事会于周二召开特别会议。会议由主席A. M.科特涅夫（A. M. Kotenev）先生主持。32个公共团体的代表出席了会议。

议程包括对理事会章程和附则的若干修订。主要关注点在于理事会究竟是依据旧的俄罗斯帝国法律运作，还是依据中国法律运作。

迄今为止，上海的俄侨公共组织一直依据管理公共协会和工会活动的旧俄罗斯帝国法律和条例进行运作。

经过热烈讨论，会议一致决定，理事会的活动应遵循中华民国现行相关法律和条例，以及国际租界和法租界区域内现行的行政和市政规章。旧俄罗斯法律的适用应仅限于符合中华民国七年《涉外民事法律适用条例》规定的情形。

会议指出，通过采纳这一原则，本理事会的实践将与所在国法律保持一致，从而促进工作的开展。

应当铭记，全俄公共协会联合会是一个非政治性、非派系性的机构，其成立旨在合法代表俄侨社区，并协调上海各俄侨公共团体的活动。

page_data.en:
THE COSSACK UNION AND L.R.A.M.KOTENEV.

The following article appears in the "Shanghai
Zaria" on August 17, 1932.:-

The extended meeting of the management of the
Cossack Home at 311 Route Vallon, having been informed in
detail of the actions of Mr. Kotenev and his assistants
regarding the organization of the Mixed-Cossack-Village,
(stanitze) consisting of the indigent Cossack (see notification in the "North China Daily News" dated July 16)
RESOLVED:- that Kotenev's actions, which are directed to
produce a cleavage in the Cossack family be recognized as
prejudical to the Cossack's interests and as deserving
particular Cossack censure. These actions, according to
their character and nature, it is to be deeply regretted,
are identical to the activities of the Bolsheviks in
Russia. Such similarity of actions is defined according
to the following data:-

1. Mendacity and public deception are the substance of the
Soviet power. Mendacity and public deception form the
foundations of the existence of the "Mixed-Cossack
Village" of indigent Cossack children, which is clearly
proved by the following facts:-

a) in accordance with the intimation made by Mr. Kotenev
in the "North China Daily News" dated July 16 the "United
Cossack Society" with the Shanghai Branch established at
the meeting of the Transbaikal Cossacks on July 26,
when "Ataman" Kotenev was elected; in accordance with
the intimation made by Mr. Fedoroff, assistant and
secretary to Mr. Kotenev, in the same newspaper dated
July 26, this Society was formed on July 26 at the
general assembly of the Amur, Ussuri and TransBaikal
Cossacks., .

b) numerical information regarding the body of the
Mixed-Cossack-Village have been knowingly exaggerated.
page_data.zh:
哥萨克联盟与L.R.A.M.科特涅夫。

以下文章刊登于1932年8月17日的《上海霞光报》（Shanghai Zaria）：-

瓦隆路311号哥萨克之家管理委员会召开扩大会议，在详细获悉科特涅夫先生及其助手关于组建由贫困哥萨克人组成的“混合哥萨克村”（stanitze）的行动后（详见7月16日《字林西报》上的通知），
决议：- 科特涅夫旨在造成哥萨克家庭分裂的行动，被认为损害哥萨克人的利益，并应受到哥萨克人的特别谴责。令人深感遗憾的是，这些行动就其性质和特点而言，与布尔什维克在俄罗斯的活动如出一辙。这种行动的相似性根据以下数据界定：-

1. 谎言和公开欺骗是苏维埃政权的实质。谎言和公开欺骗构成了贫困哥萨克儿童“混合哥萨克村”存在的基础，以下事实清楚地证明了这一点：-

a) 根据科特涅夫先生在7月16日《字林西报》上的声明，“联合哥萨克协会”及其上海分会是在7月26日外贝加尔哥萨克人会议上成立的，当时科特涅夫“阿塔曼”（Ataman，首领）当选；根据科特涅夫先生的助手兼秘书费多罗夫（Fedoroff）先生在同一家报纸7月26日刊上的声明，该协会是在阿穆尔、乌苏里和外贝加尔哥萨克人的大会上于7月26日成立的。. .

b) 关于混合哥萨克村人数量的信息被故意夸大。

page_data.en:
The persentage relatively of men, women and children are
absurdly great. all the more so as 40% of the Cossacks
are single men or left their families during the civil
war in their Cossack territory: according to the latest
official data of the Mixed-Cossack-Village, 266 women and
children (see Mr. Kotenev's letter in the "Shanghai
Zaria" dated July 23) belong to 53 Cossacks (it must be
admitted that there are single men amongst them) and the
letter of his assistant in the "North China Daily News"
dated July 26; in Mr. Feodoroffs' intimation of July 26
there is notice to the effect that the members of the
newly formed organization have not had and do not have
any connection with the Cossacks Union, in reality it
was May 29 that "Ataman" of the Society and his assistant
Feodoroff submitted a written request through the medium
of the TransBaikail Village to accept them into the
Cossack Union. It is true that the TransBaikal Village
refused their request on August 2 for reasons shown in
the Protocol;
c) In the English newspapers, the new Cossack organization
was called the "United Cossack Society" whereas in the
Russian newspapers it was called the "Mixed-Cossack-
Village"
d) Mr. Kotenev, in his letter published in the "Shanghai
Zaria" dated July 23, stated that the lists of the Village
(stanitze) "would be officially communicated to the
Cossack Union" - no such communication was made; in
accordance with the statement of his assistant Mr. Feodoroff
in the English newspaper dated July 26, the lists of the
"United Cossack Society" may be seen at any time by the
public and in reality, at a personal interviews of the
representatives of the Cossacks Union with Mr. Kotenev
on August 3 and 5, it was elucidated that no such prepared
lists of the newly formed organization exist;
page_data.zh:
男性、女性和儿童的相对比例荒谬地高。尤其考虑到40%的哥萨克人是单身男子，或在哥萨克领土的内战期间离开了家人：根据混合哥萨克村的最新官方数据，53名哥萨克人拥有266名妇女和儿童（见科特涅夫先生7月23日在《上海霞光报》上的信）（必须承认其中也有单身男子），以及他的助手在7月26日《字林西报》上的信；在费多罗夫先生7月26日的声明中，声称新成立组织的成员过去和现在都与哥萨克联盟没有任何联系，而实际上，该协会的“阿塔曼”及其助手费多罗夫曾于5月29日通过外贝加尔村提交书面申请，要求加入哥萨克联盟。诚然，外贝加尔村出于议定书中所述原因，于8月2日拒绝了他们的请求；
c) 在英文报纸中，新的哥萨克组织被称为“联合哥萨克协会”，而在俄文报纸中则被称为“混合哥萨克村”
d) 科特涅夫先生在7月23日《上海霞光报》上发表的信中称，该村（stanitze）的名单“将正式通报给哥萨克联盟”——但并未进行此类通报；根据其助手费多罗夫先生在7月26日英文报纸上的声明，“联合哥萨克协会”的名单可随时供公众查阅，而实际上，在8月3日和5日哥萨克联盟代表与科特涅夫先生的个人面谈中，已阐明并不存在此类为新成立组织准备的名单；

page_data.en:
e) Mr. Kotenev stated in the Russian newspapers that he
never applied to anybody for assistance, whereas in
"the "North China Daily News" of July 16, he opened
an appeal for subscriptions and gave his own address.
The above mentioned facts are perfectly sufficient
to give the knowing lie to Mr. Kotenev and his assistants
and to show their public mendacity.

2. The splitting up of the prpulation into social classes
and instigating these classes - one against another-
is the basic and preferred method of the Bolsheviks -
the same, method, unfortunately, is being pursued by
Mr. Kotenev here in Shanghai with the Cossack residents,
extracting from amongst them the class distinction-
"the poorest" particularly, with the low moral level type
and, playing on these base instincts, he is instigating
them (the poor) against their brother cossacks who are
living under better conditions than they are - Such
are the actions of Mr. Kotenev and by which he is
calculating to serve a blow at the Cossack brotherhood
and their traditions.

-----

Zaria dated July 23, his remark in the "North
China Daily News dated July 16 and Mr. Feodoroff's
letter in the "North China Daily News" dated July 26.

3. To divide the soldier from the officer, particularly
from the general, was a Bolshevist propaganda motive for
the purpose of demoralizing the army in 1917; similar
methods are being adopted here in Shanghai by Mr, Kotenev
after a term of 15 years which are evident from the

上述事实足以证明科特涅夫先生及其助手 knowingly lying（明知故犯地撒谎），并显示他们的公开欺诈行为。

2. 将人口划分为社会阶层并煽动这些阶层相互对立，是布尔什维克的基本和首选方法——不幸的是，科特涅夫先生在上海对哥萨克居民也采取了同样的方法，从中提取出“最贫穷者”这一阶级区分，特别是那些道德水平低下的类型，并利用这些卑劣的本能，煽动他们（穷人）反对生活条件比他们好的兄弟哥萨克人——这就是科特涅夫先生的行径，他企图以此打击哥萨克兄弟情谊及其传统。

3. 使士兵与军官，特别是与将军分离，是布尔什维克在1917年为瓦解军队士气而进行的宣传动机；15年后，科特涅夫先生在上海也采用了类似的方法，这从他信中强调的部分可以看出，他在其中声称，他的“斯塔尼察”（Stanitsa，村/社区）成员中没有将军，只有各种类型的哥萨克人。

All the foregoing cause the Cossack Union, in the interests
of self-defence, to adopt the following measures forthwith:-
1) Advise all the Cossacks of the foregoing and advise
them to doubly increase their watchfulness with respect
to Mr. Kotenev's actions and also those of his assistants.
2) Advise the Cossacks - members of the Union - to refuse
all personal connections with all those institutions
of which Mr. Kotenev is the president.

他的“斯坦尼察”（stanitze）成员中包括骑兵上尉科特涅夫（Kotenev）。科特涅夫先生正试图通过这些活动破坏哥萨克联盟中现有的传统哥萨克团结，以及将军、军官和士兵之间的完全理解。（参见7月23日《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）刊登的科特涅夫先生的信件，以及7月26日《字林西报》（North China Daily News）刊登的其助手的信件）

4. 费奥多罗夫（Feodoroff）先生作为联合哥萨克协会阿塔曼（Ataman，即首领）的助理兼秘书所发表的声明，称所有哥萨克人，无论其政治倾向如何，均被接纳进入联合哥萨克协会；同样，科特涅夫先生在5月29日于哥萨克之家举行的外贝加尔哥萨克会议上向哥萨克人发表著名呼吁时，称呼他们为“同志们”，这些事实本身已说明问题，无需进一步评论（参见7月26日《字林西报》刊登的费奥多罗夫的信件）

鉴于上述情况，哥萨克联盟出于自卫利益，立即采取以下措施：-
1) 将上述情况告知所有哥萨克人，并建议他们对科特涅夫先生及其助手的行动加倍警惕。
2) 建议身为联盟成员的哥萨克人，拒绝与科特涅夫先生担任主席的所有机构建立任何个人联系。
3). 将本决议副本发送给所有哥萨克组织以供知悉，并在报纸上刊登。

1932年8月16日《上海霞报》刊登的上海哥萨克联盟管理委员会于1932年8月11日通过的决议摘要译文

哥萨克联盟

俄罗斯哥萨克联盟上海管理委员会于1932年8月11日在哥萨克之家（地址：瓦隆路311号）召开全体会议，审议了科特涅夫（Koteneff）先生及其助手与组建由贫困阶层哥萨克组成的联合哥萨克协会有关的活动（见档案号 D.2882），通过如下决议：-

兹宣告，科特涅夫的活动对哥萨克事业有害，理应受到特别谴责，因为它倾向于在哥萨克大家庭中引起不和。令人深感遗憾的是，这种活动的精神和性质类似于布尔什维克在俄罗斯的活动。这将从以下几点看出：-

1. 谎言和误导公众舆论构成了其本质。关于科特涅夫在与组建联合哥萨克协会有关的活动中的情况（他随后就上述事实发表了冗长详细的声明，管委会认为这证明了上述指控），可以说同样的话。

2. 将人口划分为阶级并煽动一个阶级反对另一个阶级——是布尔什维克卑鄙且惯用的手段。科特涅夫正在使用同样的方法，将当地哥萨克人划分为贫困哥萨克和其他人。

3. 造成官兵之间的分裂是1917年俄国军队中布尔什维克宣传的主要动机。科特涅夫使用的方法与此类似。

4. 科特涅夫的助手费奥多罗夫（Fedoroff）先生宣称，所有哥萨克人，无论其政治倾向如何，均被接纳进入新协会。这一声明结合科特涅夫在1932年5月29日的哥萨克会议上用“同志们”一词称呼哥萨克人的事实，是不言自明的，无需评论。

因此，哥萨克联盟为了保护哥萨克人的利益，采取了以下措施：-

1. 将上述情况告知所有哥萨克人，并建议他们对科特涅夫及其追随者的活动保持极度谨慎。

2. 建议哥萨克联盟成员避免与科特涅夫担任主席的所有组织建立任何个人关系。

3. 将本决议副本发送给所有哥萨克组织以供知悉，并在报纸上刊登。

Subject (in full) "The Union of Russian Cossacks"

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature] D.I.

With reference to the attached cuttings from the
North China Daily News on the subject of the Cossacks Union
inquiries show that this organization first came into existence
in 1925, and occupies offices at No.311 Route Vallon. The
chairman is Colonel J.K. Bologoff, and it is one of the few
White Russian organizations which performs real good work.
The headquarters comprise a mess, a school for the teaching of
the English language, a cinema and a recreation ground for
members children and a dormitory for unemployed members.
Lectures on world political affairs and on military subjects are
frequently given on the premises. The members of the union are
exclusively Cossacks and are organized into "Staniza" (villages).
The union is the hub of all Cossack activities in Shanghai, and
has 587 male members and 436 women and children on its roll.
Being a national patriotic organization the union is not in any
way connected with the two leading Russian groups in Shanghai,
namely the Russian Emigrants Committee headed by Mr. Metzler,
and Soro (Council of United Russian Public Organizations in
Shanghai), organized in January 1932 under the chairmanship of
Mr. A.M. Kotenff (File D.2882), who are known to be hostile to
each other. The Union of Russian Cossacks does not recognize
either of these organizations as being representative of the local
Russian community, and in the past has urged that in order to
properly represent the Russian Community the unification of
these two societies is essential (File D.2882).
Owing to the independent attitude adopted by the
Cossacks union, and its refusal to join "Soro" has resulted
in certain hostile activities on the part of the leaders of the
abovementioned organizations which have been directed against the

主题（全称）“俄国哥萨克联盟”

编制人 D.S. Tcheremshansky. 转呈人 [签名] D.I.

参照附件中《字林西报》关于哥萨克联盟的剪报，调查显示该组织最早成立于1925年，办公地点位于华伦路（Route Vallon）311号。主席为 J.K. Bologoff 上校，它是少数几个从事真正有益工作的白俄组织之一。其总部设施包括食堂、英语学校、电影院、会员子女游乐场以及失业会员宿舍。经常在该场所举行关于世界政治局势和军事主题的讲座。联盟成员 exclusively 为哥萨克人，并按“Staniza”（村社）进行组织。该联盟是上海所有哥萨克活动的中心，名册上有587名男性成员以及436名妇女和儿童。作为一个民族爱国组织，该联盟与上海两个主要的俄国团体没有任何关联，即由 Metzler 先生领导的俄国移民委员会，以及于1932年1月在 A.M. Kotenff 先生（档案 D.2882）主席领导下组织的 Soro（上海俄国公共组织联合会），众所周知这两个团体彼此敌对。俄国哥萨克联盟不承认这两个组织中的任何一个能代表当地俄国社区，并且过去曾敦促认为，为了恰当地代表俄国社区，这两个社团的统一至关重要（档案 D.2882）。
由于哥萨克联盟采取独立态度，并拒绝加入“Soro”，导致上述组织的领导人对其采取了某些敌对活动，这些活动针对

to create dissension among its ranks in order to create a new
organization for Cossacks which will support "Soro". Immediately
after the organization of Soro and the refusal of the Union of
Russian Cossacks to join this formation, General Afanassieff, Don
Cossack by birth, who is the paid secretary of Soro, left the
Cossacks union taking with him five supporters and organized a
United Don Staniza. On May 29, 1932, A.M. Koteneff applied for
membership to the Russian Cossacks Union. At the same time the
"Group of Standard Bearers", headed by the well known Colonel
V. Kazakoff, and in which Kotenev was recently appointed a
member started negotiations regarding the unification of this
group with the Transbaikalian Staniza of the Russian Cossacks
Union. The negotiations failed to materialize and as a result
of Kotenev's activity in the organization of the "United Cossacks
Association," his application for membership in the Union of Russian
Cossacks has been rejected, vide a resolution passed at a meeting

The strongest clique in this organization belongs to
Colonel Kazakoff's "Group of Standard Bearers" while the remainder

Some of them have already received monetary support.
V. Kazakoff, chairman of the "Group of Standard Bearer", was
formerly a non-commissioned officer in the Cossacks Guard
Regiment during the Great War and received his present rank
while serving with Ataman Semonoff. During the evacuation of
the White Russian Army he was entrusted with the evacuation of
the families of Cossack soldiers and the colours of the
Transbaikal troops. In Shanghai Kazakoff has utilized these
colours as a means of securing money ostensibly to keep them
in good condition.
In 1930 V. Kazakoff was a member of the 1st Russian
Military Scientific Society in China. At that time he was
supported by Colonel Kolesnikoff, chairman of this Society
(File C.2060). He then joined the Russian Legitimist Monarchist
Organization but was later dismissed for disobeying an order of
General Jadvoín, who was the head of organization then. In
order to obtain funds for the upkeep of the colours Kazakoff
organized a "Cossacks Ball", but it is reported that he converted
the money to his own personal use.
On February 14, 1927 V. Kazakoff appeared before the
French Mixed Court on a charge of drunk and disorderly and was
sentenced to seven days imprisonment which however was suspended.

其中一些人已经获得了金钱支持。
V. 卡扎科夫，“旗手团”主席，曾在大战期间担任哥萨克卫队的士官，并在谢苗诺夫阿塔曼（Ataman Semonoff）麾下服役期间获得目前的军衔。在白俄军队撤离期间，他受托负责撤离哥萨克士兵的家属和外贝加尔部队的军旗。在上海，卡扎科夫利用这些军旗作为手段，名义上是为了保持其良好状态而筹集资金。
1930年，V. 卡扎科夫是中国第一俄罗斯军事科学学会的成员。当时他得到该学会主席科列斯尼科夫上校（Colonel Kolesnikoff）的支持（档案 C.2060）。随后他加入了俄罗斯正统君主主义组织，但因违抗时任该组织负责人贾德温将军（General Jadvoín）的命令而被开除。为了筹集维护军旗的资金，卡扎科夫组织了一场“哥萨克舞会”，但据报道，他将这笔钱挪作私用。
1927年2月14日，V. 卡扎科夫因醉酒滋事出现在法国会审公廨，被判处七天监禁，但缓刑执行。

Mr. Kotenev is not a Cossack by birth but bases his
claim on the fact that he served with Transbaikal Cossacks
Regiment during the Russo-Japanese War of 1905. Since then he
has resided in Petrograd but has had no connection with Cossacks
or their organizations. In Shanghai until May, 1932, Kotenev
did not display any interest in Cossack affairs and had no local
connection with them in any shape whatever.

The secretary of the union is P.S. Fedoroff,
Transbaikalien Cossack, former copyist in Administration of
Transbaikal Cossacks in Chita. He arrived in Shanghai a few
years ago from Hankow and until recently has taken no active
party in the affairs of the Cossack community. In Hankow it is
reported he had a doubtful reputation and was said to borrow
money which he failed to pay back.
The new organization as formed by Mr. Kotenev under
the name of the "United Cossacks Association" claims to represent,
according to a statement published on February 16, 1932 in the
North China Daily News, the poorest class of Cossacks residing

secretary P.S. Fedoroff it is mentioned that the new organization

The tendency of this organization is to emphasize the fact that
it is composed of the poorer Cossack elements only. A house

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, JULY 22, 1932
4160

COSSACKS UNION
A Statement
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS."
SIR,—Will you kindly publish the
following in your esteemed paper:—
The Board of the Cossacks' Union
at its meeting on July 17 on being
acquainted with a notice appearing
in the "North-China Daily News"
on July 16 under the heading "New
Organisation for Cossacks" in order
to clarify the actual state of affairs
decided to publish the following
statement:—
1.—The Cossacks' Union in
Shanghai exists since May, 1925 and
at present moment counts amongst
its members:—12 generals, 28 staff
officers, 129 subaltern officers, 23
ex-civil servicemen and 295 cossacks
of rank and file. Altogether 587
men. There are also 436 women
and children. To the "New Or-
ganisation for Cossacks" the Union
has no relation whatever and knows
nothing about it.
2.—The Cossacks' Union is aware
that at the initiative of new mem-
bers of the Cossacks' Union under
the leadership of Mr. Kotenev was
created a small group, the actual
membership of which the Union is
taking steps to find out.
3.—Major-General Lovtzoff is the
Ataman of the Transbaikal Cos-
sacks belonging to the Union.
4.—The worry for the newly ar-
riving Cossacks displayed by Mr.
Kotenev's group is entirely uncalled
for, as it is a rule of the Cossacks'
Union that every newly arriving
and lacking means Cossack is entit-
led to the lodgings and board at
the Cossacks Home until he finds
employment.
5.—To illustrate the effort of the
Union in that respect the Board
gives the following figures for
fifteen days:—from July 1 to July
15 there were 10 boarders at the
Cossacks Home, to support whom
cost Union, $72.50; the burials of
two Cossacks cost, $35.00; the rent
of the premises for the unemployed
$25.00; medical assistance, $20.00.
Total, $152.50.
At the end of the each year the
detailed annual reports are drawn
by the Board of the Union and
after their confirmation at the
general meeting of the Union pub-
lished in the Russian press.
G. E. BOGAEFF
Chairman of the Union of
Russian Cossacks
Shanghai, July 21, 1932.

S2, For comment please.
A.S. Tchaikovsky
J.M. 22/7/32

哥萨克联盟
一份声明
致《字林西报》编辑：
先生，—恳请贵报刊登以下内容：—
哥萨克联盟董事会在7月17日的会议上，获悉7月16日《字林西报》在“哥萨克新组织”标题下刊登的一则通知，为了澄清实际情况，决定发表以下声明：—
1.—上海哥萨克联盟自1925年5月存在至今，目前其成员包括：—12名将军，28名校级军官，129名尉级军官，23名前文职人员以及295名普通哥萨克士兵。共计587人。另有妇女和儿童436人。联盟与“哥萨克新组织”毫无关系，对其一无所知。
2.—联盟知悉，在联盟新成员科特涅夫先生的领导下，成立了一个小团体，联盟正在采取措施查明其实际成员人数。
3.—洛夫佐夫少将（Major-General Lovtzoff）是隶属于联盟的外贝加尔哥萨克的阿塔曼。
4.—科特涅夫团体对新抵达哥萨克人所表现出的担忧是完全不必要的，因为哥萨克联盟的规定是，每一位新抵达且缺乏资财的哥萨克人都有权在哥萨克之家获得食宿，直到找到工作为止。
5.—为了说明联盟在这方面所做的努力，董事会提供以下十五天的数据：—从7月1日至7月15日，哥萨克之家有10名寄宿者，供养他们的费用为72.50美元；两名哥萨克人的丧葬费用为35.00美元；失业者住所租金为25.00美元；医疗援助费用为20.00美元。总计152.50美元。
每年年底，联盟董事会会编制详细的年度报告，经联盟大会确认后，在俄文报刊上发表。
G. E. 博加耶夫（G. E. BOGAEFF）
俄罗斯哥萨克联盟主席
上海，1932年7月21日。

S2, 请予评论。
A.S. 柴可夫斯基（A.S. Tchaikovsky）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JULY 16, 1932

NEW ORGANISATION
FOR COSSACKS

Assistance to the Needy and
Their Families Planned

For the purpose of mutual
assistance and to support the needy
and their families, a new organisa-
tion called the United Cossacks
Association, Shanghai Branch, has
been established. Owing to lack of
funds, public contributions are be-
ing taken care of by Mr. A. M.
Katenev, of the Council of the
United Russian Public Organisa-
tions at 39 Avenue Edward VII.
The new Association represents
the poorest class of Cossacks in
Shanghai, many of whom have been
out of employment for a long
period. It has a membership of
more than 250. Of the number, 110
are heads of large families and of
different armies, while the re-
mainder are women and children.
The Association was organised at
a meeting of Transbaikal Cossacks
held on July 26, when Mr. A. M.
Katenev was elected the Ataman.
With the influx of Cossack re-
fugees from the north, the increase
of the membership of the Associa-
tion is expected in a short time.
The activities of the Ataman and
several of his assistants are to
secure employment for the most
needy members and to provide them
with clothing. It has been planned
to open a refuge and a soup kitchen,
but lack of funds is delaying the
programme.

（批：88R）

4165
《字林西报》，1932年7月16日，星期六

哥萨克新组织

计划援助贫困者及其家属

为了互助并支持贫困者及其家属，一个名为“联合哥萨克协会上海分会”的新组织已经成立。由于缺乏资金，公众捐款由爱德华七世路39号全俄公共组织理事会的A. M. 卡特涅夫（A. M. Katenev）先生负责处理。
新协会代表上海最贫困阶层的哥萨克人，其中许多人长期失业。其会员人数超过250人。其中，110人是大家庭的家长，来自不同的军队，其余为妇女和儿童。该协会是在7月26日举行的一次外贝加尔哥萨克会议上组织的，会上A. M. 卡特涅夫先生当选为阿塔曼。
随着来自北方的哥萨克难民的涌入，预计该协会的会员人数将在短时间内增加。
阿塔曼及其几名助手的活动旨在为最贫困的成员寻找工作并提供衣物。原计划开设一处收容所和一个施粥处，但因缺乏资金，该计划被推迟。

（批注：88R）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, JULY 26, 1932
4168

COSSACKS IN SHANGHAI
Another View

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS."
SIR,—The Board of the United
Cossacks Association at its extra-
ordinary meeting on July 22, upon
being acquainted with the statement
by G. K. Bologoff, chairman of the
Union of Russian Cossacks, publi-
shed in your paper, feel compelled
to add some further information as
to the position of the above-named
organisation.
The United Cossacks Association
was formed on July 26 by the
unanimous vote of all present at
the meeting of Transbaikal, Amur
and Ussuri cossacks.
These cossacks have never had
any connection with the Union of
Russian Cossacks under Mr. Bolo-
goff, and still refuse to have any-
thing to do with his organisation.
The newly-formed association has
at the present time 165 cossacks and
shows a tendency to increase its
membership.
The Association has not a single
general and only one staff officer
amongst its members, the rest all
being from rank and file, though
some of them formerly held com-
missions in the army.
There are also 406 women and
children. The association keeps an
up-to-date list of its membership
and their families signed by each
individual member and open at any
time for public inspection.
The United Cossacks do not rely
on the support of any particular
institution. Poor as they are, they
have raised amongst themselves
sufficient money to help needy
cossacks irrespective of their poli-
tical sympathies and party affilia-
tions.
The United Cossacks is not the
only body which does not recognise
the claim to supreme authority by
the Cossacks Union under Mr.
Bologoff.
Amongst these may be men-
tioned Mr. Bologoff's Union and the
Semirechensky cossacks, the Don,
Kuban, Terek and Ural cossacks
and the Korniloff's Stanitsa of the
Siberian cossacks, and they are well
aware of the modus operandi of
Bologoff's Union and the actual
number of cossacks forming its
membership.
P. S. FROLOFF,
Assistant of Ataman and
Secretary of the United
Cossacks Association.
Shanghai, July 25, 1932.

《字林西报》，1932年7月26日，星期二
4168

上海的哥萨克人
另一种观点

致《字林西报》编辑：

先生，——联合哥萨克协会董事会在7月22日召开的特别会议上，获悉贵报刊登的俄罗斯哥萨克联盟主席G. K. Bologoff（音译）的声明后，感到有必要就上述组织的地位补充一些进一步的信息。

联合哥萨克协会是由外贝加尔、阿穆尔和乌苏里哥萨克会议的所有出席者一致投票，于7月26日成立的。

这些哥萨克人与Bologoff先生领导下的俄罗斯哥萨克联盟从未有过任何联系，并且仍然拒绝与其组织发生任何关系。

新成立的协会目前拥有165名哥萨克人，并显示出成员人数增加的趋势。

该协会成员中没有一名将军，只有一名参谋军官，其余均为普通士兵，尽管他们中的一些人曾在军队中担任委任军官。

此外还有406名妇女和儿童。该协会保存着一份最新的成员及其家属名单，由每位成员亲自签名，并随时供公众查阅。

联合哥萨克人不依赖任何特定机构的支持。尽管他们很贫穷，但他们已在内部筹集了足够的资金，以帮助有需要的哥萨克人，而不问其政治倾向和党派归属。

联合哥萨克人并不是唯一不承认Bologoff先生领导下的哥萨克联盟声称拥有最高权威的团体。

在这些团体中，可以提到的是Bologoff先生的联盟以及谢米列奇耶（Semirechensky）哥萨克人、顿河（Don）、库班（Kuban）、捷列克（Terek）和乌拉尔（Ural）哥萨克人，以及西伯利亚哥萨克的科尔尼洛夫（Korniloff）村社（Stanitsa），他们都很清楚Bologoff联盟的运作方式及其成员构成的实际哥萨克人数。

P. S. FROLOFF（音译），
阿塔曼助理兼
联合哥萨克协会秘书。

On March 17, 1932 the Presidium of the Council of
United Russian Public Organizations at Shanghai (SORC) discussed

election of members of the S.M.C.

It was pointed out by Mr. Kotenev that the numerical

are those who reside in the outlying districts were offered
motor car transportation to convey them to the polling booths
on the election days.

circulated a similar message to the Russian ratepayers recommend-
ing them to vote for the following candidates :- Messrs A.D. Bell,
G.E. Marden, I.T. Hughes and Captain Behnson. These candidates
are also supported by the Russian Orthodox Confraternity.

During the evening of March 18 a meeting of Russian
ratepayers was held at Tkachenko's Cafe, No.495 Avenue Joffre.
This meeting was convened on the initiative of Mr.A.G.Chibunovsky
of A.G. Chibunovsky & Co, 477 Bubbling Well Road, who urged
those present to support Messrs Arnhold and Bell. The candidature
of the first named was strongly objected to by certain rate-
payers on the ground that he was pro-Chinese and that during
his previous term of chairmanship of the S.M.C. he had betrayed

1932年3月17日，上海俄罗斯公共组织联合会理事会（SORC）主席团讨论了俄罗斯社群参与上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）董事选举的问题。

Kotenev（音译）先生指出，俄罗斯社群在上海的人数规模、日益增长的商业和职业利益要求积极参与本市的市政事务。因此，请求俄罗斯纳税人（约160人）履行其义务，投票给以对俄罗斯社群友好态度著称的候选人。主席团推荐的候选人是 A.D. Bell 和 H.E. Arnhold 两位先生。随后向俄罗斯纳税人 circulated 了这一内容的消息，并为居住在郊区的纳税人提供了汽车交通服务，以便在选举日将他们送往投票站。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, JANUARY 22, 1932
（印：REGISTRY D. 2881 22. 1. 32）

RUSSIAN COMMUNITY
CHAIRMAN.

An Answer

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS."

SIR,—For eight years, since I subscribed to your esteemed paper, I did not write a single letter to the Editor, but the letter of "Russian Democrat" calls for an answer.
It is not accurate in the following respects:
(1) Mr. A.M. Kotenev was elected, not by "political bodies supporting the so called Russian "Obschina" only, but by majority of political and non-political bodies, who support the idea of unification of the Russian Community here in Shanghai, and have striven for it for years—as against minority, represented by the Immigrant Committee, which was always against any unification, for reasons which need not be exposed here. These could have been more or less justified, when Mr. V. T. Grosse was its Chairman.
(2) "The Union of Russian Cossacks" is not the only Cossack organisation in Shanghai and certainly not the largest. The reason for their representatives leaving the meeting is obscure and cannot be based on "democratic principles," as further the Meeting manifested universal desire to overcome petty jealousies, by election of President, members of which (four out of five) are independent either of the Immigrants' Committee or "Obschina."
(3) It is a gross misrepresentation that 15,000 members of the Russian Community were not represented on the Meeting, because even assuming this—there is no body which can claim their representation with a right then.
It is to this end—formation of Representative Body elected by the whole Russian Anti-Bolshevick Community, that "The Council for the United Public Organisations" was created. A vast amount of work is ahead of this "Council" before the conditions allowing a general vote can be attained.
(4) The Meeting resolved also, that the "Council" will take all and every step in order to incorporate in itself all the public bodies, including the Immigrants' Committee, reconstructing itself or even changing its by-laws for this purpose.
In conclusion I may add that "Russian Democrat" and those with whom he is associated, are playing a losing game.
True sportsmanship does not allow "bad taste", nor does it allow "hitting low."
RUSSIAN SUBSCRIBER.
Shanghai, Jan. 20, 1931

俄罗斯社群
主席。

答复

致《字林西报》编辑：

先生，——自从我订阅贵报八年来，我未曾给编辑写过一封信，但“俄罗斯民主人士”的来信需要回答。
其在以下方面不准确：
(1) A.M. Kotenev（音译）先生并非仅由“支持所谓俄罗斯‘Obschina’（公社）的政治团体”选出，而是由大多数支持上海俄罗斯社群统一理念并为此奋斗多年的政治和非政治团体选出的——这与以移民委员会为代表的少数派形成对比，后者出于此处无需揭露的原因，一直反对任何统一。当 V. T. Grosse（音译）先生担任其主席时，这些原因或许多少有些正当理由。
(2) “俄罗斯哥萨克联盟”并非上海唯一的哥萨克组织，当然也不是最大的。其代表离开会议的原因不明，且不能基于“民主原则”，因为会议进一步表现出克服 petty jealousies（小嫉妒/狭隘嫉妒）的普遍愿望，通过选举产生的主席团成员（五人中的四人）独立于移民委员会或“Obschina”。
(3) 声称15,000名俄罗斯社群成员未在会议上得到代表，这是一种严重的歪曲，因为即使假设如此——当时也没有任何团体有权声称代表他们。
正是为了这一目的——建立一个由整个俄罗斯反布尔什维克社群选举产生的代表机构，“公共组织联合理事会”才得以成立。在实现允许进行普遍投票的条件之前，这个“理事会”还有大量工作要做。
(4) 会议还决议，“理事会”将采取一切步骤，以便将所有公共团体，包括移民委员会，纳入其自身，为此重组自身甚至修改其章程。
最后，我可以补充说，“俄罗斯民主人士”及其同伙正在玩一场必输的游戏。
真正的体育精神不允许“品味低劣”，也不允许“下三滥手段”。
俄罗斯订阅者。
上海，1931年1月20日

重要会议
为巩固本地俄侨社区事务作出新努力，著名作家、历史学家兼上海公共租界工部局秘书处成员 A. M. Kolesov 先生，最近当选为“俄国公共组织联合会”主席。除“俄侨委员会”和“俄罗斯东正教兄弟会”外，上海所有俄人社团均派代表出席了会议，此举在整个俄侨社区引起了轰动。

会议在瓦伦路（Route Valin）的市立礼堂（Salle de Fetes Municipale）举行，由 Glebov 将军主持大会及主席和理事会的选举程序。各俱乐部和协会的重要成员在会上发言，表达了希望在此呈现团结一致的俄国阵线的尝试终获成功的愿望。

科列索夫（Kolesov）主席面临着艰巨的任务，他试图组织其同胞，而这些同胞早已卷入难以打破的政治阵营之中。尽管“层层嵌套”的对抗性代理人可能会继续围绕那些阻碍理想目标联合的各种人物旋转，但这位新主席有望弥补 V. Th. Gessen 先生去世带来的损失；Gessen 先生曾任“俄侨委员会”负责人，长期以来是本地外交界的风云人物。

对科列索夫主席的任期有利的一个因素是年轻一代的态度，与那些更年长、更倾向于他们认为无望且定义模糊的人相比，年轻一代与在上海的俄国流亡者的未来联系更为紧密
